Entries.Title: High Cookie
Entries.Description: The top student in Class S of Jeonghan High School mysteriously dies. Knowing the real cause of death, Min-young struggles to cover up the incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The top student in Class S of Jeonghan High School mysteriously dies. Knowing the real cause of death, Min-young struggles to cover up the incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Soo-young happens to give the mysterious cookie to someone at work. But this one cookie becomes a threat to the sisters' lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While investigating Yoo-jung's death, a detective notices that the cookie is at the center of the case. Min-young attempts to derail the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: A detective visits Soo-young after discovering the cookie's connection to Min-young. Infuriated by the accusation, Soo-young looks for the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Seong-pil, a consultant at the school, calls Min-young privately and offers to help her. Meanwhile, Soo-young's investigation of the cookie leads her to the school.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With Seong-pil's help, Min-young tries to get out of the cookie business and turn herself in. However, her plans go awry when she encounters an unexpected person.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Soo-young heads to the school to avenge Min-young and takes Won-ju, a cookie distributor, hostage. The chef doesn't budge, and Ho-soo gets caught up in the fight.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: To save Min-young, Soo-young decides to become an employee of High Cookie. She disguises herself as a transfer student and sells the cookies at Jeonghan High School.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Soo-young's seemingly smooth business faces a crisis as she gets involved with Jin-woo, the chairman's grandson. Is it all a part of Soo-young's operation?

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Through a sweet school life with the cookies, Soo-young often forgets about Min-young. Meanwhile, Seong-pil tries to use Soo-young to find Chef.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Soo-young is confused when she discovers Chef's true identity. In hopes that it's not true, she tries to test him, but Chef falls into Soo-young's trap.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Soo-young learns that Chef can't create an antidote to save Min-young. Despite a momentary setback, Soo-young tries to obtain the antidote in her own way.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Soo-young needs the antidote, and Seong-pil needs the recipe. The two are now in the race to get to Ho-soo first.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Soo-young and Ho-soo hide from Seong-pil. The two start investigating Seong-pil to find out his weakness.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Min-young wakes up in an unknown place. Meanwhile, Soo-young negotiates with Seong-pil to find out where Min-young is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Soo-young goes to the place where Min-young is supposed to be, but she is not there. Meanwhile, Ho-soo and Seong-pil fight for their lives.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Soo-young returns to her ordinary life with Min-young. Before they know it, the sisters' positions are reversed. Soo-young starts to miss the cookie's taste.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Soo-young realizes that she can never go back to her nice life without the recipe. But if she gets the recipe, does that mean she can live the life that she wants?

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: People are now looking for the cookie recipe. Chef asks Soo-young if she's confident enough to handle the recipe.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Chef leaves one last thing for Soo-young. Meanwhile, the school becomes a mess because of the cookies Soo-young made. Will Soo-young be able to handle this and become the next Chef?

Entries.Title: Call It Love
Entries.Description: With the sudden news of her father's death, Woo-joo is forced out of her home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: With the sudden news of her father's death, Woo-joo is forced out of her home.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Best Fairs's business secrets are leaked and Woo-joo is blamed as the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Woo-joo receives an unexpected offer, and CEO Shin plans to destroy Best Fair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Best Fair's project is put on hold, and Woo-joo has a secret rendezvous.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Woo-joo wavers as Dong-jin falls apart. Things proceed according to CEO Shin's plans.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Best Fair is driven to the brink. Amidst the chaos, Woo-joo and Dong-jin are contacted separately.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Ji-gu is one step closer to finding out Dong-jin's identity, and Woo-joo fixes her mistakes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Woo-joo asks Dong-jin for a favor. Someone begins to question Woo-joo's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: CEO Shin tries to win over Woo-joo, but Woo-joo and Dong-jin work as a team.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Jun's concerns deepen, and Dong-jin musters up the courage to face Woo-joo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Woo-joo tells Hyun-ju what she has been up to, and someone reveals those secrets to Sun-woo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: An unwelcome guest visits Dong-jin's house. A suspicious man approaches Hyun-ju with information.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Woo-joo's family finds out Dong-jin's secret. Dong-jin notices a change in Sun-woo's attitude.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Woo-joo prepares to leave and Dong-jin tries to right wrongs, when they both hear shocking news.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Hyun-ju and Hee-ja meet again in the same place for the first time in thirteen years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Woo-joo and Dong-jin prepare to say goodbye. Will they send each other off smiling?

Entries.Title: Delightfully Deceitful
Entries.Description: Moo-young has only been taking cases of high-profile clients due to his health condition. But he can no longer suppress the passion in him, so he decides to take the Geumseong murder case. Thanks to him, Ro-um gets exonerated. After being released from prison, Ro-um quickly finds a way to make money using her photographic memory.

Episodes.Title: The Genius Girl
Episodes.Description: Moo-young has only been taking cases of high-profile clients due to his health condition. But he can no longer suppress the passion in him, so he decides to take the Geumseong murder case. Thanks to him, Ro-um gets exonerated. After being released from prison, Ro-um quickly finds a way to make money using her photographic memory.

Episodes.Title: The Jeokmok Kids
Episodes.Description: Moo-young learns that Ro-um was one of the kids sponsored by the Jeokmok Foundation. He learns the history of how Ro-um grew up and why she had to confess that she killed her parents. Meanwhile, Ro-um calls her old friends to carry out the plan she has been planning all her life.

Episodes.Title: Your Values
Episodes.Description: Ro-um catches a man trying to capture her photos and finds out how he's been taking photos of random women secretly. When Moo-young comes to help her, Ro-um suggests unlawful ways to punish him. Meanwhile, Moo-young looks for ways to help Ms. Seo, who lost her son after she gave him up for adoption.

Episodes.Title: Save Ringgo
Episodes.Description: Ro-um uses all the ways to win Myung-hoon's insurance money that is worth 400 million won. Yo-han pays a surprise visit at Moo-young's place, and Moo-young covers up for Ro-um who was hiding there. Meanwhile, Ringgo gets kidnapped by a voice phishing ring, and Ro-um comes up with a way to save Ringgo.

Episodes.Title: The Accomplice
Episodes.Description: After finding out about Jeokmok Kids, Moo-young declares to Ro-um that he'll help with her fraud. The Jeokmok Kids come together as a whole after Nasa joins them. They begin a new operation, and they use Moo-young as their frontman. Ro-um is determined to show him the difference between a con artist and a lawyer.

Episodes.Title: The Arrest
Episodes.Description: Ro-um calls the police on Moo-young, setting him in a trap. But Moo-young quickly thinks of a way to make his way out of the situation. Meanwhile, Ye Chung-sik gets killed in his cell, and the killer names Ro-um as his instigator.

Episodes.Title: The Notebook
Episodes.Description: Ro-um reveals to Moo-young what happened between her and Director An ten years ago. To obtain the notebook containing the identity of the president, Ro-um and her team disguise themselves and break into the hotel vault. Moo-young requests to meet Jang Kyung-ja in person to hack into her phone.

Episodes.Title: The Old Enemy
Episodes.Description: Ro-um and the gang carry out the operation as planned, but a series of unexpected events occur. Yo-han finds out that his mother was an advisor for Jeokmok Foundation and confronts her. Moo-young realizes who was behind his father's company's fraud case that destroyed his family.

Episodes.Title: Truth Behind Jeokmok and Navis Well-being
Episodes.Description: Moo-young calls Prosecutor Ryu and Reporter Woo to help dig into Jeokmok Foundation and Navis Well-being. Ma Kang-soo, the CEO of Darusa International, gets out of prison, which puts Jang Kyung-ja in a pickle. Jae-in learns that the subjects she studied in college were none other than the Jeokmok Kids themselves.

Episodes.Title: The Victims Come Together
Episodes.Description: Moo-young decides to map the whole organization, and Ro-um uses her eidetic memory to recall the contents of the ledger. The Jeokmok Kids join hands with Prosecutor Ryu and Reporter Woo to bring Jeokmok down. Meanwhile, Moo-young hears the news about his father.

Episodes.Title: Who is on Your Side?
Episodes.Description: Ro-um and her team try to get their hands on Kang-soo's plan for his stock price manipulation. Yeon Tae-hoon gets on Kang-soo's nerves and gets fired. Kang-soo demands a copy of the notebook from Kyung-ja. Meanwhile, Moo-young demands Ro-um to tell him why she wants Jay on their team.

Episodes.Title: Delightfully Deceitful
Episodes.Description: Yo-han and Jae-in disguise themselves as a couple and attend Min Kang-yoon's party. Ringgo also attends the party with fake identification, but he fails to capture her attention. Instead, Kang-yoon shows interest in Ro-um. Meanwhile, Kang-soo manages to get the money for his investment, but something unexpected happens at the investment briefing.

Episodes.Title: The President's Identity
Episodes.Description: Da-jung's server gets hacked, and they lose all the data they stole from Navis. The crew thinks it's the president's doing. Moo-young suggests a class action lawsuit, which can have the prosecution search and seize Navis' properties. But this plan doesn't go well, so they decide to commit fraud again.

Episodes.Title: The Last Resolution
Episodes.Description: Moo-young learns what his father did to earn the money for his tuition. Su-ho sees the photo Ringgo sent and realizes who the president is. Ro-um receives a gift from Jay, which leaves her staggered. Then she realizes that the only way to end everything is to get rid of the president herself.

Episodes.Title: The One You Trust
Episodes.Description: Ro-um gets arrested as the prime suspect of Jang Kyung-ja's murder. Moo-young comes up with a plan to get Ro-um out of the prosecutors' office and protect Da-jung, Su-ho, and Ringgo at the same time. Meanwhile, the truth behind Jang Kyung-ja's death gets revealed.

Episodes.Title: The Final Blow
Episodes.Description: Da-jung collects all the evidence against Jay and organizes them so they can be used against him. Ro-um faces Jay head-to-head and demands he return the money he made through Navis. The Jeokmok Kids end up in court pleading guilty to their crimes.

Entries.Title: Lies Hidden in My Garden
Entries.Description: Ju-ran, a woman with a perfect life in a perfect house, feels anxious about the strange smell from the backyard. Sang-eun, a pregnant woman who suffers from poverty and domestic violence, hears the news of her husband's sudden death.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ju-ran, a woman with a perfect life in a perfect house, feels anxious about the strange smell from the backyard. Sang-eun, a pregnant woman who suffers from poverty and domestic violence, hears the news of her husband's sudden death.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Right before his death, Yun-beom shows up at Ju-ran’s house unannounced and mentions the night-fishing meeting with Jae-ho, and Sang-eun later finds out that Yun-beom was in debt. Meanwhile, Ju-ran ends up discovering fingers buried in the backyard...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: "Your husband killed my husband." After hearing these shocking words from Sang-eun at Yun-beom’s funeral, Ju-ran begins to find suspicious traces of Jae-ho one by one. Sang-eun finds a picture of Jae-ho and a strange girl together in a mysterious cell phone that Yun-beom hid, and begins to scheme to blackmail Jae-ho for money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ju-ran goes to see Sang-eun and suggests the two of them find out the truth about Jae-ho together. Meanwhile, Sang-eun gets a call from Jae-ho, and as Ju-ran secretly watches the two meet, she is confused about which of the two to believe...

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The identity of Yun-beom's murderer is finally revealed! While being with Sang-eun, Ju-ran sees a side of Jae-ho that she has never seen, but she decides to protect her family. However, it turns out there is another secret hidden in her house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With Seung-jae's confession, Ju-ran discovers the truth behind the strange smell and noise, and even Jae-ho's secret. Her entire life is on the brink of collapse. Meanwhile, Sang-eun uncovers a secret hidden in Ju-ran's house on Yun-beom's phone that she has received from the police.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Now that Sang-eun knows about the secret of Ju-ran's family, she blackmails Ju-ran. But Ju-ran gives Sang-eun 200 million won and makes an unexpected proposal…

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Sang-eun realizes that she fell into Ju-ran and Jae-ho's trap. But when things go awry, Jae-ho threatens both Ju-ran and Sang-eun, and Ju-ran makes a dangerous decision when she sees his true colors.

Entries.Title: Joseon Attorney: A Morality
Entries.Description: Han-soo settles in Hanyang and opens an attorney's office. Being notorious for his rude attitude, he gets no customers for a long while. One day, a plum wine seller asks him to file a lawsuit against the leader of the biggest guild in Joseon, and the magistrate holds a court for this case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Han-soo settles in Hanyang and opens an attorney's office. Being notorious for his rude attitude, he gets no customers for a long while. One day, a plum wine seller asks him to file a lawsuit against the leader of the biggest guild in Joseon, and the magistrate holds a court for this case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Han-soo tricks Master Jang into standing as a witness for Pyo, a vicious criminal. He makes Master Jang make a false statement and get blamed for Pyo’s crime instead. Princess Yeon-joo decides to help Han-soo punish both Master Jang and Pyo. After seeing what Han-soo is capable of, she decides to use him for her future plans.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Lady Yeon, the wife of Commissioner Park, leaves her home to stay in Sowongak. It turns out that Commissioner Park abused her and intentionally killed her father to take all of his property. She wants to file a divorce suit against her husband, but it's difficult for a woman to do so in Joseon. Then Han-soo steps up to help her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: So-won misunderstands Han-soo's intention and fires him. She finds another attorney to defend Lady Yeon and tries gathering evidence against Commissioner Park. Han-soo also works behind So-won, convincing Myung-wol to testify for Lady Yeon. However, on the day of the trial, no attorney shows up to defend Lady Yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After Commissioner Park dies, Han-soo searches his room and finds the jade dragon. Han-soo, Dong-chi, and So-won head to Cheongsan to find out who gave the jade dragon to Commissioner Park. Han-soo learns it was Lady Park's doing, so he heads to her house. However, he witnesses a murder scene when he gets there.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Han-soo comes up with a brilliant idea to save the newlywed bride, Young-sil. He makes the villagers turn against each other and confess. He even successfully calls Ji-seon to Cheongsan so he can report the murder case to the King well. Meanwhile, Yoo Je-se learns about Han-soo and realizes that all the cases he took weren't mere coincidence.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After So-won realizes who Han-soo is, she becomes devastated as he might not forgive her if she tells him the truth behind his parents' death. Han-soo asks Ji-seon to help him find the princess, but Ji-seon gives him a new case instead, which involves Lord Chu and Lord Chu's son.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Lord Chu deliberately cancels Lee Bong-sam's trial and does everything in his power to stop Han-soo. Just as when Han-soo was feeling helpless, So-won comes up with a brilliant idea to solve the case. Meanwhile, after Executive Minister Yoo learns about Lord Chu's son's case, he decides to take action.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Han-soo decides to fire So-won and stay away from her so he can keep her away from trouble. He focuses on taking cases that could lead him to the King. However, the King himself visits him and asks him to take a case regarding the new commissioner. Han-soo starts his investigation on Kwon Myung-woo, the new commissioner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Han-soo looks deeper into Lord Kwon's case, and he finds out that a member of the Royal Family is involved in it. That leaves the King no choice but to cancel the new commissioner's appointment. Meanwhile, while trying to protect Han-soo from getting arrested, So-won has no choice but to reveal her true identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Han Soo gets falsely accused of murdering Lord Chu. So Won steps up to be his witness, but Han Soo refuses, feeling betrayed that So Won has been fooling him the entire time. Han Soo gets tortured, and he is forced to make a confession when a group of witnesses burst into the interrogation hall.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Chu Sal comes to Han Soo and asks for his help. He shares how Lord Won Dae Han is trying to take the lands his brother worked hard to cultivate. With Han Soo's help, Chu Sal files a lawsuit against Lord Won. However, he has a slim chance of winning as Lord Won is one of Executive Minister Yoo's men.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Han Soo gets to meet Ji Sun at the bar for middle-class women and widows. Eun Soo is shocked to know that Je Se is the one who caused the death of Han Soo's parents. Grand Queen Dowager visits the merchant house and says the house must disappear so that Princess Yeon Joo would never come back to the house.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Han Soo must find ways to save Eun Soo from getting executed, but there is nothing he can do to stop it.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Yeon Joo suggests Ji Sun to use their wedding ceremony as a chance to interrogate Executive Minister Yoo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The King wishes to punish Executive Minister Yoo with a death sentence, but Han Soo offers a different idea.

Entries.Title: Miraculous Brothers
Entries.Description: Fate seems relentless for Dong-ju as he encounters a car accident and learns of his mother's DUI offense, further adding to his hardships. Like many others who reach rock bottom in real life, Dong-ju makes an unwise decision when he accidentally comes across the script of a novel belonging to the victim of his car accident. To his surprise, the novel achieves great success. However, the situation takes a turn when the boy Dong-ju hit finally regains consciousness.

Episodes.Title: A Miraculous Boy
Episodes.Description: Fate seems relentless for Dong-ju as he encounters a car accident and learns of his mother's DUI offense, further adding to his hardships. Like many others who reach rock bottom in real life, Dong-ju makes an unwise decision when he accidentally comes across the script of a novel belonging to the victim of his car accident. To his surprise, the novel achieves great success. However, the situation takes a turn when the boy Dong-ju hit finally regains consciousness.

Episodes.Title: Who or What Am I?
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju's primary concern upon the boy regaining consciousness is whether his old memories have returned. Dong-ju is fully aware of his grave mistake and feels obligated to reveal the truth, regardless of whether he remembers anything or not. Simultaneously, as the murder cases and missing persons investigations progress, the similarities between them intensify, leading to a growing momentum. However, Dong-ju has no idea how this would affect him.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Past
Episodes.Description: Hyun-soo suggests putting up a banner to look for Kang-san’s family. Kang-san gets discharged from the hospital and decides to stay at Dong-ju’s place. While inspecting the site of the accident, Kang-san sees a boy and follows him. Kang-san finds out that the boy has been abused by his mother. Meanwhile, Hyun-soo visits Dong-ju at his place and asks what motivated him to write the novel.

Episodes.Title: What Happened 27 Years Ago
Episodes.Description: Hyun-soo tells Dong-ju that the murders in his novel are happening in real life. Dong-ju thinks Hyun-soo’s claim is outrageous, but he finds out that she is right. But Dong-ju doesn't report it to the police because he's afraid of losing the luxury he's enjoying. Meanwhile, Byung-man visits Assemblyman Byun and asks about the murder case from 27 years ago.

Episodes.Title: Connecting The Dots
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju visits his old high school’s principal and sees a photo of a man who looks exactly like Ki-jeok. He asks around and finds out that the man in the photo is Lee Kang-san who went missing in 1995 with his brother, Lee Ha-neul. Meanwhile, Ki-jeok tells Dong-ju that his memories are coming back and that he remembers meeting Dong-ju’s father.

Episodes.Title: The Novel That Will Save A Man
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju realizes the connection Ki-jeok has with his dad. No Young-nam kidnaps Assemblyman Byun’s daughter and demands the assemblyman to confess that he tortured him 27 years ago. Assemblyman Byun’s daughter coincidentally passes by Ki-jeok, and Ki-jeok realizes that she needs help. When Dong-ju faces No Young-nam, he asks Dong-ju to save him.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Man
Episodes.Description: Dong-ju realizes that the videotape No Myung-nam mentioned could be important evidence, so he looks for it. Ki-jeok visits Woo-jung's cafe and sees the photo of Kang-san, which brings back some of his memories. Meanwhile, during Dong-ju’s book signing event, a mysterious man drops by and leaves him a note.

Episodes.Title: Tell Me The Truth
Episodes.Description: Ki-jeok calls Hyun-soo and asks her to find his family with his real name, Lee Kang-san. He then meets Woo-jung and asks her about his brother. During police interrogation, No Myung-nam has a panic attack and passes out. Meanwhile, Dong-ju finally meets Lee Tae-man and talks about his novel.

Episodes.Title: Candid Conundrum
Episodes.Description: Kang-san persists in probing Dong-ju's awareness of his identity, raising tough questions about when and how he became aware. Although Dong-ju acknowledges his mistakes, he also believes that certain things are best left unspoken. As a result, he resorts to a convenient truth. Meanwhile, Dong-ju is confronted with plagiarism allegations concerning his best-selling novel, and he may have to shoulder the blame alone if things turn against him.

Episodes.Title: A Skeleton At Sopyung Lake
Episodes.Description: The discovery of skeletal remains and a student card with Lee Ha-neul's name at Sopyung Lake marks a significant shift in the investigation. Kang-san is heartbroken, fearing the loss of his brother. Meanwhile, Hye-kyung becomes suspicious of Tae-man's attention towards the boy living with Dong-ju. Acting as if she is unfamiliar with the boy, Hye-kyung accepts Kang-san's picture from Tae-man but immediately visits Dong-ju's house, bringing a mysterious gift.

Episodes.Title: An Ally or a Foe?
Episodes.Description: Dong-joo and Kang-san stumble upon a flash drive inside a gift Hye-kyung left behind after her short visit. The data inside seems significant enough to shake the whole country. The two feel the need to be honest with each other if they are to work together toward the truth. Meanwhile at the station, the flash drive goes missing, and the last person who held on to it was Detective Kim. Kang-san's pursuit of his brother continues.

Episodes.Title: Closing In
Episodes.Description: The police investigation intensifies as they start suspecting Byun Jong-il's involvement in the Jeon Doo-hyun murder case. Simultaneously, No Myung-nam is discovered in an alleged suicide attempt. Meanwhile, Kang-san confides all his secrets to Hyun-soo, who then seeks a favor from him. However, Dong-joo vehemently rejects the idea for Kang-san's well-being. On a hospital bed, Myung-nam remains unconscious, and Kang-san tries to read his troubled state of mind.

Episodes.Title: Byun Jong-il Disappears
Episodes.Description: The discovery of skeletal remains and a student card with Lee Ha-neul's name at Sopyung Lake marks a significant shift in the investigation. Kang San is heartbroken, fearing the loss of his brother. Meanwhile, Hye-kyung becomes suspicious of Tae-man's attention towards the boy living with Dong-ju. Acting as if she is unfamiliar with the boy, Hye-kyung accepts Kang San's picture from Tae-man but immediately visits Dong-ju's house, bringing a mysterious gift.

Episodes.Title: Byun Jong-il Is Dead
Episodes.Description: As the police approach the truth, Lee Tae-man's discomfort grows, causing him to make rushed mistakes. Dong-ju uncovers news of Byun Jong-il's death and holds himself responsible for failing to elicit a confession regarding his father's murder. Meanwhile, Kang San finally meets his brother and comprehends why Ha-neul is adamant about keeping Kang San away. At the same time, Dong-ju has his own agenda to finalize things definitively.

Episodes.Title: The Public's Right to Know
Episodes.Description: Dong Ju drops a bombshell during a TV show, bringing to light all the concealed facts related to Lee Tae-man and others, including his own undisclosed matters. This disclosure causes a shift in the investigation, prompting individuals previously deemed unlikely to cooperate to come forward voluntarily for interrogation by the police. Meanwhile, an individual approaches Kang San with the demeanor of a guilty party, earnestly seeking forgiveness.

Episodes.Title: I'm Sorry
Episodes.Description: Kang San is regretful for losing control and causing harm to Dong-ju. Dong-ju reassures him that he's fine, but he expresses concern about his recent instability. Meanwhile, the police are on the verge of apprehending Lee Tae-man and Choi Jong-nam, but their window of opportunity is closing rapidly. Byung-man pays a visit to Chang-geun, expressing remorse for not giving more attention to the young individual who sought his help 27 years ago.

With Tae Min and Soo Kyung back from their honeymoon, Tae Hee strategically plans her escape during a momentary diversion of attention. Hyo Jun's decision to give up his studies faces staunch opposition from Mi Rim, who refuses to let him throw in the towel. Hyo Sim takes decisive steps toward shaping her future.

After spending a honeymoon practically separately, Tae Min and Soo Kyung begin their marriage, which is only for show. Meanwhile, Soo Kyung offers to help Tae Min with his promotion by using the power of the press to disturb Tae Ho, while Tae Hee returns home with Hyo Do, and Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim by her hand to see her mother, Sun Soon.

She even throws some harsh words at Sun Soon, who ends up showing a lot of disappointment. Tae Min learns about Tae Ho digging deeper into the Daegwallyeong Pass incident through Soo Kyung, who isn't happy with how Tae Min is treating her. Meanwhile, Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim to where his parents are laid to rest.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: So, Tae Ho straight-up asks Tae Min if he's got the lowdown on what really went down with their old man's death. Things get heated, and they end up throwing punches. Later, Tae Ho crashes at Hyo Sim's pad, asking if he can crash there for the night. On the flip side, Tae Min is hustling hard to secure the top spot at Taesan Group, and he leaves Soo Kyung with scars while doing so. Meanwhile, Hyo Sim and Tae Ho are all lovey-dovey in a parking lot, clueless that they've got an audience.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Myung Hee finally meet and shed tears of joy. Myung Hee tells Tae Ho to keep her a secret. With the money Hyo Sim gave her, Sun Soon takes over a cafe. Although Tae Min gets promoted to vice chairman, Tae Ho plans to stop him from becoming the chairman. Meanwhile, Tae Min and Soo Kyung's marriage shatters, and rumors at TS Fitness begin to spread.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim tells her boss she is quitting TS Fitness after he interrogates her about her relationship with Tae Ho. Tae Ho senses something isn't right with Hyo Sim and rushes to her house. However, he runs into Hyo Sung as he is leaving her place. Meanwhile, Myung Hee offers the chairman of TV Live a proposal, and Sook Hyang sets Tae Ho in a trap when things look dire between Tae Min and Soo Kyung.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: As Tae Ho falls into Sook Hyang's trap and gets taken away by the police, he asks Hyo Sung to look after Hyo Sim. Hyo Sim is shocked at the news, and she lets Tae Min know how horrible she feels when he comes to her about what happened with Soo Kyung. On the opening day of Sun Soon's cafe, Hyo Jun, who couldn't get over Mi Rim, shows up drunk and makes a mess. Meanwhile, Hyo Do meets with Tae Min, wanting to strike it rich, and tells him about Tae Hee.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho's imprisonment exposes a distinct purpose, leading to Tae Min's interrogation visit. Despite Tae Min's inquiries, Tae Ho remains unwilling to provide any answers, causing frustration for Tae Min. Myung Hee starts disclosing Sook Hyang's heinous deeds on TV Live, leaving Sook Hyang uneasy. Hyo Sung, who dedicated his life to his job, faces termination. Thanks to Hyo Sung, Hyo Sim reconnects with Tae Ho and learns about Tae Ho's grandmother.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Tae Min and Myung Hee sit face-to-face, where Myung Hee ensures Tae Min's steadfast commitment to safeguarding Taesan Group. Recently released from prison, Tae Ho declares a management war against Sook Hyang and Jin Bum. Hyo Sim, spotting Tae Ho waiting for her outside her house, joyfully runs into his arms and informs him that her mother wants to meet him. Meanwhile, Mi Rim desperately searches for Hyo Jun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim scolds Hyo Jun on behalf of Sun Soon, who has collapsed at the news of Mi Rim's pregnancy. Tae Ho grumbles sadly at Hyo Sim for having to leave Sun Soon's house. Myung Hee pressures Jin Bum to confess to the Daegwallyeong Pass incident, and later, Tae Min finds Jin Bum collapsed on the floor. Meanwhile, Sook Hyang frets about the prosecutor's investigation, and Mr. Yeom tells Tae Min that Myung Hee is behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Mi Rim's unexpected remarks turn Hyo Sim's house upside down, and Sun Soon falls ill again. Sook Hyang gets taken in for questioning by the prosecution, and Tae Ho searches for evidence one last time. Hyo Sung resorts to a loan shark for his children's education but runs into Hyo Do. Meanwhile, Tae Ho tries to earn brownie points with Hyo Sim's family by helping at the cafe, and Tae Min sees his world crumble as he learns Myung Hee's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Myung Hee reveals the truth to Tae Ho, but Tae Ho can't hide his bewilderment. Sun Soon succumbs to Mi Rim's determination and approves her wish to find her husband. Tae Min leaves his resignation letter and keeps himself out of sight, but Tae Ho finds him. Meanwhile, Hyo Do takes a beating from Mr. Yeom and his men when he goes to help Hyo Sung, and Sook Hyang offers TV Live a proposition that could destroy Taesan.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: While Tae Ho and Tae Min stay up all night looking for a way to stop TV Live's attack on Taesan Group, they seem to become closer. Hyo Sim fervently spreads flyers to find her father and later comforts Tae Ho after learning about his relationship with Tae Min. Meanwhile, Tae Hee returns home after signing divorce papers and finds Mr. Yeom's attitude towards her suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim races to a piano academy and finds traces of her father there after hearing new information about him. Tae Ho warns Sook Hyang to leave Tae Min alone, and Sook Hyang plans to dump all crimes on Mr. Yeom. Ru Bi takes Pil Lip to Indangsu and learns everything about Hyo Sung's painful circumstances. Meanwhile, Jin Bum, who cannot contain his remorse, tells Tae Min the truth behind the Daegwallyeong incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Jin Bum apologizes to Tae Min and says he will go to prison. Hyo Sung accidentally finds a picture of a woman at the piano academy with Hyo Sim that they believe was where their father last stayed. Myung Hee gives Tae Min the dashcam footage of the Daegwallyeong Pass incident, and Tae Min and Tae Ho learn what happened. Meanwhile, Hee Ju tells Sun Soon that Tae Ho belongs to the family that runs Taesan Group, and Sun Soon calls Hyo Sim over right away.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
Episodes.Description: Sook Hyang's longstanding deceitful behavior toward Mr. Yeom may soon have consequences. With Tae Min's help, Hyo Sung re-enters Taesan Group and persuades Hyo Sim to cease searching for their father. Tae Ho's visit to Uicheon Villa is an attempt to gain Sun Soon's approval for his marriage to Hyo Sim, but he is met with coldness from Sun Soon. Meanwhile, Tae Hee confides in Tae Min about a secret she has been keeping.

Episodes.Title: Episode 46
Episodes.Description: Tae Min tells Tae Ho that he will take care of everything and for him to get married and live a happy life. Hyo Sung finds Mr. Yeom's old phone and gives it to Tae Min, and Tae Ho gets in touch with Park Jin Myung. Tae Ho valiantly tries to win Sun Soon's heart, and Sun Soon is stunned at his behavior. Meanwhile, Kkeut Soon is shocked when she sees her grandson, who is supposed to be in the US, in the cafe. She and Hyo Sim track him down to find out more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 47
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho and Tae Min reunite with Park Jin Myung when he returns to Korea to give them crucial documents that will put Sook Hyang away for good. Kkeut Soon locks herself in her room after her heart breaks over her family. While Myung Hee tries to console her, Taesan Group requests her return, and she has no choice but to leave Uicheon Villa. Meanwhile, Sun Soon sobs when she sees how beautiful Hyo Sim is on the runway of a fashion show, and Tae Ho takes Hyo Sim to where they first meet to propose to her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 48
Episodes.Description: Hyo Sim meets her father, Chu Ryeon, who doesn't recognize her, and she reveals who she is in his hospital room. Hyo Sung meets Mi Hee, his music instructor from when he was a child. And through her, he learns why his father had left his family. Tae Ho takes Sun Soon to meet Myung Hee about his marriage to Hyo Sim. Meanwhile, Tae Ho and Hyo Sung get promotions for their parts in revealing the truth, and Hyo Sim meets Mi Hee when she goes to see Chu Ryeon again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 49
Episodes.Description: Tae Ho becomes upset at Hyo Sim's words to postpone their wedding, and they fight over it. Sun Soon reunites with Chu Ryeon but collapses out of bitter anger. She warns Hyo Sung and Hyo Sim never to think about giving Chu Ryeon their liver. Tae Ho asks Tae Min to postpone his promotion, and Hyo Jun goes to take his lawyer's exam. Meanwhile, Hyo Sim's family takes matters into their own hands to protect their family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 50
Episodes.Description: Knowing Hyo Sim went into the operating room to donate her liver, Sun Soon sobs in agony in front of the doors. While worrying about Hyo Sim for being out of touch, Tae Ho realizes something horrible has happened when he sees Hyo Sung missing from his desk. After the surgery, Hyo Sim questions her life while watching her family restabilize at her sacrifice. Meanwhile, Tae Hee and Tae Min visit Sook Hyang at the corrections facility, and Tae Ho rushes to the hospital when he finds out about Hyo Sim.

Episodes.Title: Episode 51
Episodes.Description: It's been one year since Hyo Sim left, but Tae Ho still waits for her. Carrot is born, and Hyo Jun becomes a lawyer. Besides that, all is the same at Hyo Sim's house. However, they all reflect on how inconsiderate they were to Hyo Sim as they live on. Tae Min picks up Jin Bum, who is getting released with a special pardon, at the prison. Meanwhile, Tae Ho sees Hyo Sim in an interview on TV and rushes out to find her. Will Tae Ho and Hyo Sim's reunion be beautiful?

Entries.Title: The Kidnapping Day
Entries.Description: Myeong-jun accepts his ex-wife Hye-eun's proposal to kidnap an 11-year-old girl named Ro-hee to pay for his daughter's hospital bills. En route to execute his plan, someone collapses before his car, which turns out to be Ro-hee. He takes her home, but she can't remember anything when she wakes up. Myeong-jun claims to be her dad and contacts her parents for the ransom, but they can't be reached.

Episodes.Title: The Kidnapping
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun accepts his ex-wife Hye-eun's proposal to kidnap an 11-year-old girl named Ro-hee to pay for his daughter's hospital bills. En route to execute his plan, someone collapses before his car, which turns out to be Ro-hee. He takes her home, but she can't remember anything when she wakes up. Myeong-jun claims to be her dad and contacts her parents for the ransom, but they can't be reached.

Episodes.Title: False Accusation
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun finds out that Ro-hee's parents have been murdered. He can no longer demand ransom or bring Ro-hee back to her home. As he heads to Ro-hee's home, a suspicious figure approaches Ro-hee who is home alone. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, the detective in charge of the case of the murdered hospital director and his wife, learns of their daughter's kidnapping and begins tracing Myeong-jun's footsteps.

Episodes.Title: The Accomplice
Episodes.Description: Ro-hee finds out that Myeong-jun is not her dad but a kidnapper. Myeong-jun decides to take Ro-hee to the police station and turn himself in. Right then, Ro-hee regains a part of her memory and is left in shock. Meanwhile, Sang-yun discovers something about Myeong-jun's past.

Episodes.Title: The Monster
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun and Ro-hee stay the night at Hye-eun's house, the mastermind behind the kidnapping. Ro-hee is in disbelief when she discovers Myeong-jun's decision to take all the blame for kidnapping her. Ro-hee remains suspicious of Hye-eun and, in the end, finds out the real reason for Hye-eun leaving Myeong-jun and Hee-ae. Meanwhile, Sang-yun finally faces Myeong-jun after an unyielding pursuit.

Episodes.Title: The Genius Child
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun and Ro-hee find themselves in Choi Jin-tae's villa. Myeong-jun learns of "The Genius Child Project," a brain experiment Ro-hee was a subject in. Dr. Mo attempts to separate Ro-hee and Myeong-jun. Meanwhile, Sang-yun digs into a case from 30 years ago to catch the culprit of the hospital director and his wife's murder case and hears an unexpected name from a witness of a past case.

Episodes.Title: The Negotiation
Episodes.Description: Ro-hee's escape from Mo Eun-sun and Jaden is short-lived, as Jaden catches her. Myeong-jun finds himself waking up on a stowaway boat. He puts his life on the line and fights to return to Ro-Hee. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, who learns from Myeong-jun about Ro-hee's partially recovered memory, hears shocking news of a murder case while chasing Cheol-won.

Episodes.Title: The Mole
Episodes.Description: In an attempt to escape again, Myeong-jun and Ro-hee request help from someone. Jaden threatens Myeong-jun and Ro-hee as he receives a call from the kidnapper about a negotiation. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, investigating Hye-eun's connection to a murder case involving Cheol-won, discovers something about Dr. Choi Jin-tae's long-term experiment.

Episodes.Title: The First Child
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun turns to Sang-yun for help to save Ro-hee. However, Jaden, who deems Ro-hee as a subject of the experiment and an investment opportunity, also does not give up and pursues her. Meanwhile, Sang-yun, swayed by Myeong-jun's genuine concern for the kidnapped child, places his trust in Myeong-jun to turn himself in but gets put in a tough position when he doesn't show up.

Episodes.Title: The Girl
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun and Hye-eun's complicated past unravels, and Sang-yun remains resolute in his suspicions about Hye-eun. However, Sang-yun gets suspended for failing to apprehend Myeong-jun and can no longer investigate the murder and kidnapping cases. Meanwhile, Myeong-jun hides himself in Hye-eun's house and discovers a mysterious object. Myeong-jun's suspicions about Hye-eun begin to grow.

Episodes.Title: Counterattack
Episodes.Description: Hye-eun aims to exchange Choi Jin-tae's research material with Jaden, and her true colors come to light. Jaden attempts to send Ro-hee overseas along with the research material. However, Ro-hee searches for ways to escape her situation. Myeong-jun, who is struggling to save Ro-hee from Jaden, turns to Sang-yun for help, who continues to pursue Myeong-jun despite being suspended.

Episodes.Title: Smoking Gun
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun is torn between his suspicions of Hye-eun and his desire to believe in her. An alliance between the kidnapper, the kidnapped child, and the detectives in pursuit of them is formed to confront Jaden and his men. With their combined efforts, Ro-hee finally returns home, but an unexpected visitor appears.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Myeong-jun gets arrested in front of Ro-hee. Ro-hee and Sang-yun work together to prevent Myeong-jun from being falsely accused and to reveal the truth about the murder of the hospital director and his wife. Meanwhile, Hye-eun learns of Myeong-jun's arrest, finalizes her deal with Jaden, and leaves in search of freedom.

Entries.Title: Korea-Khitan War
Entries.Description: Queen Dowager Cheonchu wishes her own son to become the next crown prince. However, Mokjong is not happy with how Kim Chi Yang, the Right Senior Executive, and Queen Dowager are trying to take over his place as he is determined to succeed the throne to King Taejo's descendant. Therefore, Mokjong is about to summon Prince Daeryangwon back to the palace, while Kim Chi Yang and Queen Dowager secretly send assassins to murder him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Queen Dowager Cheonchu wishes her own son to become the next crown prince. However, Mokjong is not happy with how Kim Chi Yang, the Right Senior Executive, and Queen Dowager are trying to take over his place as he is determined to succeed the throne to King Taejo's descendant. Therefore, Mokjong is about to summon Prince Daeryangwon back to the palace, while Kim Chi Yang and Queen Dowager secretly send assassins to murder him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Court Lady Choi threatens Prince Daeryangwon to take the food Queen Dawager has prepared for him. Prince Daeryangwon quickly runs away from the temple and hides himself in Mount Samgak. Court Lady Choi orders the men to burn down the mountain to find him. Meanwhile, Mokjong holds a banquet for his people, and Kim Chi Yang plots a crime for the night.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kang Jo, Northwest Temporary Government Officer, sets off for Gaegyeong with a crucial mission. However, deep within his thoughts, he grapples with the realization that Goryeo's very existence is at stake if the current state of ruling persists. Meanwhile, in another part of the kingdom, Prince Daeryangwon anxiously awaits assistance from His Majesty. To his surprise, he finds himself confronted with an entirely new chapter of life, carefully orchestrated for him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Caught in the crossfire between those gearing up for war and those working to prevent it, the puppet king, Wang Sun, and Kang Gam Chan form the front line of those seeking to avert conflict. On the opposing side, Kang Jo believes in the inevitability of war and sees it as a chance to eradicate the Khitans. The turning point comes when envoys from Khitan arrive with a message poised to alter the course of history.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The ministers struggle to dissuade the Khitan envoys as Prince Daeryangwon expected. He believes that Khitan is using the Palace Head Secretary's treason to justify the war. Therefore, Prince Daeryangwon summons Kang Jo alone to his chamber at night to get rid of him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description:
Details

The battle between Goryeo and Khitan begins in the middle of the night, and the people of Goryeo shiver with fear. With 400,000 soldiers, Khitan attacks Heunghwajin for seven days straight, but they are unable to destroy the fortress. Therefore, they come up with another strategy. Meanwhile, Prince Daeryangwon visits the temple where people are gathered to pray.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The Emperor of Khitan is infuriated as he loses the first conquest expedition he is leading. He starts advancing south with his army towards Samsuchae to destroy Goryeo's main force. Therefore, even though Officer Yang manages to defeat Khitan soldiers, the main force assumes Heunghwajin has lost the battle as they are trapped. Officer Yang must find a way to send the word.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The spearhead commander of the Khitan army launches an attack and captures Kang Jo. The emperor of Khitan threatens Kang Jo and the captured generals to become vassals of Khitan. Meanwhile, Hyeonjong receives the news that the Goryeo army was defeated, and Deputy Minister Kang advises him not to share the news with the people.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Hyeonjong sends Deputy Minister Kang to Khitan's camp as an envoy to relay his message. However, the commander of Khitan's army does not trust his words and decides to hold him back in their camp. Furthermore, Deputy Mayor Won of Seogyeong Fortress gives up on fighting against Khitan and is about to surrender.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As the Khitans advance southward, Kang Gam Chan urges Wang Sun to consider a strategic withdrawal for a greater purpose. Wang Sun's unwavering loyalty to his people clashes with the stark reality of limited options. With Gaegyeong in the crosshairs, Wang Sun stands on the precipice of a crucial decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Kang Gam Chan makes a critical decision to stay back in Gaegyeong, sacrificing himself to create a window for Wang Sun's escape. Despite Kang Gam Chan's noble sacrifice, Wang Sun encounters unforeseen dangers at every step of his journey. Meanwhile, Yang Kyu is devising a plan to reclaim Gwakju, the current base of the Khitan army.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: The realization of the hardships encountered by those south of Gaegyeong leaves Wang Sun with a sense of emptiness. The difficulties they face highlight his shortcomings as a king, evoking a deep sense of disappointment in himself. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan finds himself in captivity as he attempts to secretly rendezvous with Xiao Paiya.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: As his people turn against him, Wang Sun bears the weight of shame for not living up to their expectations as their emperor. Entrusting them with his fate, he seeks to ease the suffering of his people. Ha Gong Jin, following Kang Gam Chan’s plans, heads toward the heart of the Khitan army with a diplomatic letter.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Upon reaching Gongju, Wang Sun receives a warm welcome from Kim Eun Boo, the governor, and one of his daughters. Wang Sun discerns a hidden agenda in the daughter's intentions but soon recognizes her potential as someone crucial for Goryeo in these challenging times. The Khitan army begins withdrawing from Gaegyeong, prompting Yang Kyu to seize the moment and launch an attack.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Yang Kyu throws himself into the Khitan army to rescue prisoners, fully aware that this might be his last battle. As expected, he and the remnants of his forces find themselves pitted against the Khitan army in overwhelming numbers. Meanwhile, Wang Sun receives news of the Khitan army's retreat and hurries back to Gaegyeong. Witnessing the state of Gaegyeong, he falls to his knees in despair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: In the face of opposition, Wang Sun remains unwavering in his commitment to overhaul the core issues haunting Goryeo, aiming to fortify the nation and spare his people from the ravages of war. Nevertheless, dissenters argue that certain priorities must be addressed before delving into Wang Sun's proposed changes. Meanwhile, the Khitans are gearing up for another confrontation with Goryeo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: In the face of strong opposition, Wang Sun persists in pursuing his goals, alongside Kim Eun Boo. Kang Gam Chan, while sharing Wang Sun's ultimate objective, disagrees with his approach and goes to great lengths to persuade him otherwise. Eventually, Wang Sun remains unwavering in his convictions and removes Kang Gam Chan from his position. To curb Kim Eun Boo's influence on Wang Sun, Kang Gam Chan implements assertive actions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: The queen consort seeks to punish Kim Eun-bu while the king is away from the palace. But guilt leads Kang Gam-chan to attempt to spare the commander.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: With Kang Gam-chan's help, Wang Sun succeeds in launching reforms. However, the local governance is unhappy, and Kang Gam-chan faces the consequences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun puts his life on the line during an intense confrontation with regional lords to bring about reform in Goryeo's regional domain. With Kang Gam Chan's return to the royal court, Wang Sun secures a reliable ally. Concurrently, the Khitans exert pressure on Wang Sun to fulfill the homage promised during the recent war.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: The Khitans demand that Goryeo cede its territories to prevent another war, turning a tribute issue into a crucial decision for Goryeo. With time running out, conflicting opinions emerge, and amidst this urgency, Kim Eun Boo takes a perilous gamble for a daring escape.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun prepares for battle while Kim Eun Boo, risking his life, attempts to provide Wang Sun with updates on the Khitans' situation. Meanwhile, during this critical moment, military officials in Goryeo decide to oppose Wang Sun's orders, insisting on the restoration of their rightful authority. Kang Gam Chan departs for Heunghwajin with the orders issued by Wang Sun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: On the edge of the northeastern border and lacking battlefield expertise, Kang Gam Chan encounters a looming confrontation with the unyielding Jurchens. Meanwhile, Wang Sun overlooks the insubordination displayed by military officials, while the brewing anger and rage inside Kim Hoon and Choi Jil persist.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: Amidst Goryeo's financial struggles, Kim Hoon and Choi Jil launch a rebellion, citing the seizure of military officers’ properties as their justification. Wang Sun, lacking sufficient guards for protection, finds himself surrounded by his own forces. Meanwhile, border troops mobilize toward Gaegyeong to aid Wang Sun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Kim Hoon and Choi Jil threaten the lives of Wang Sun's vassals, compelling him to order the soldiers heading to Gaegyeong to retreat. With circumstances turning against Wang Sun, he faces a dilemma, torn between doing what is right and safeguarding his innocent vassals. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan and other vassals operate in the shadows, clandestinely searching for the mastermind behind the rebellion.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun successfully pursues and apprehends Park Jin, but he is constrained by his own lack of authority. He subsequently seeks to persuade Kim Hoon, who is engaged in a dispute with Choi Jil, to quell the uprising. Meanwhile, a second envoy from Khitan returns to Goryeo, demanding that the King of Goryeo pay tribute to prevent hostilities.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: The vassals, having received Wang Sun's directives, ready themselves to suppress the rebels at Seogyeong. Although Wang Sun, accompanied by the rebels, eventually reaches Seogyeong, those expected to execute his commands are conspicuously absent. Nevertheless, there may be an undisclosed scheme underway to prevent Wang Sun from crossing the Yalu River.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Wang Sun eradicates the rebel faction and prepares for war against the Khitans. In 1018, the final and decisive battle between Goryeo and the Khitans draws near. With Kang Gam Chan leading the Goryeo army as its commander, they embark on their journey toward the ultimate confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: The Khitan Army's maneuvers raise suspicion as they actively evade engaging with the Goryeo forces and persistently advance solely southward. Recognizing their strategic intent, Kang Gam Chan advises Wang Sun to consider seeking refuge, but Wang Sun adamantly issues strict orders to defend Gaegyeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Accompanied by his remaining soldiers, vassals, and the people of Goryeo, Wang Sun ventures beyond the fortress boundaries with the intention of minimizing the suffering of his people. Meanwhile, Kang Gam Chan clashes with the retreating Khitan forces on the plains of Kwiju, marking the onset of the war.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: The culmination of the war sees Goryeo emerging triumphant over the Khitans. Kang Gam Chan's return is a scene of jubilation, with the citizens of Gaegyeong celebrating his victory. Yet, Wang Sun, undeterred by the momentary glory, devises a plan aimed at ensuring enduring tranquility in Goryeo.

Entries.Title: Love to Hate You
Entries.Description: Yeo Mi-ran’s distaste for petty, philandering men grows even stronger. Nam Kang-ho offends his finicky co-star on the set of their drama.

Episodes.Title: Bad Girl
Episodes.Description: Yeo Mi-ran’s distaste for petty, philandering men grows even stronger. Nam Kang-ho offends his finicky co-star on the set of their drama.

Episodes.Title: Bad Boy
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran starts a new job at a previously all-male law firm where she navigates awkward encounters with a top client, an ex-boyfriend and a familiar foe.

Episodes.Title: Nice Guys Get a Pass Bad Boys Have It Coming
Episodes.Description: After catching Kang-ho in what seems like a compromising position, Mi-ran becomes determined to get close to him so she could bring him to justice.

Episodes.Title: You Are Not What I Expected
Episodes.Description: While prepping for the role of his dreams, Kang-ho turns to martial arts enthusiast Mi-ran for help. Oh Se-na, an old flame, re-enters the picture.

Episodes.Title: Love is Just an Experiment, Life is the Real Thing
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran bats away unwanted advances — including a tricky birthday surprise. Kang-ho's reputation is threatened when false dating rumors go public.

Episodes.Title: Femme Fatale vs Homme Fatale
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran and Kang-ho begin a whirlwind — but fake — romance to combat questions surrounding the actor's sexuality. Do Won-jun meets Mi-ran's roommate.

Episodes.Title: Trigonometry: The Love Triangle Edition
Episodes.Description: Feelings start to get a bit too real between Mi-ran and Kang-ho. Despite knowing Kang-ho's apparent relationship status, Oh Se-na tries to win him back.

Episodes.Title: The Way You Change Me
Episodes.Description: When Mi-ran gets hurt, Kang-ho realizes his feelings for her are deeper than he imagined. Won-jun and Shin Na-eun flirt with teaming up — and each other.

Episodes.Title: You Made Me Who I Am
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran and Kang-ho get serious and vulnerable with each other. To get over her crush on Won-jun, Na-eun tells him about her most embarrassing habits.

Episodes.Title: A Passionate Goodbye
Episodes.Description: News of Mi-ran's dating history gets out, making her a social pariah. Will she and Kang-ho give in to pressure and break up, or will love prevail?

Entries.Title: Love Mate
Entries.Description: Yi Jun is upset when the new hire at his company Ha Ram questions the content of his project during a presentation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Yi Jun is upset when the new hire at his company Ha Ram questions the content of his project during a presentation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ha Ram starts to make advances, but the cold and distant Yi Jun who doesn't care for love, remains unimpressed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Yi Jun keeps using dating apps for work-related purposes, but it's through one of these apps that he makes an unexpected match.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After Ha Ram tells Yi Jun the reason why he likes him, Yi Jun finally shares his previous negative experiences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ha Ram and Yi Jun decide to become "date mates," and set up ground rules for their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Yi Jun's proposal is extremely successful, and it attracts a handsome model who wants to participate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Yi Jun's ex, who hurt him deeply in the past, shows up, which makes Yi Jun depressed, and Ha Ram also realizes something is amiss.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ha Ram and Yi Jun are about to end their date mate relationship, will they move on to the next stage together?

Entries.Title: Brain Works
Entries.Description: Dr. Shin Ha-ru is fired after illegally acquiring a criminal’s brain. He volunteers to help Detective Geum Myeong-se's bureau — and to make him pay.

Episodes.Title: Cooperation As Yet Unheard Of
Episodes.Description: Dr. Shin Ha-ru is fired after illegally acquiring a criminal’s brain. He volunteers to help Detective Geum Myeong-se's bureau — and to make him pay.

Episodes.Title: The Most Brilliant Moment
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru and Myeong-se's first case involves a famous guitarist and his wife, who turned herself in for his murder. But Ha-ru turns the case on its head.

Episodes.Title: I Don't Know My Wife's Face
Episodes.Description: A Vietnamese woman is found dead with her face and hands burnt. Her husband suffers prosopagnosia; her best friend has disappeared. Both are suspects.

Episodes.Title: Things That Are Visible When You Close Your Eyes
Episodes.Description: New evidence and test results drastically change the face of the case. A killer approaches Ha-ru, saying he wants to donate his brain to neuroscience.

Episodes.Title: The Girl With The Wicked Spirit
Episodes.Description: A 6-year-old with aphasia gets turned in by her mother. She believes a demon has possessed her daughter to kill — and her husband has paid the price.

Episodes.Title: How To Be Saved Forever
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru exposes the truth before the child’s exorcism can take place. And a tablet reveals some dirt on the detective, much to the doctor's delight.

Episodes.Title: A Man Cheating With His Wife
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru’s attempt to sully Myeong-se embarrassingly backfires. A man reports his wife missing to the police, claiming a "virtual human" attacked her.

Episodes.Title: Love, The Basic Instinct
Episodes.Description: After a husband's confession, his wife shows symptoms of conversion disorder. Who killed who? Ha-ru gives up his revenge and leaves the department.

Episodes.Title: Reset Man
Episodes.Description: A suspect whose memory resets every 30 minutes claims he has killed his mother. Ha-ru returns, intrigued by a patient with anterograde amnesia.

Episodes.Title: Though Memories Fade, feat. How to Forget Bad Memories
Episodes.Description: The stepbrother becomes a prime suspect as the siblings’ harrowing tale comes to light. On his date with So-jeong, Myeong-se gets a call about a body.

Episodes.Title: A Brain on Trial
Episodes.Description: The perpetrator who left a mysterious note at the murder scene demands a reduced sentence. Unaware of Dong-u’s plan, Ha-ru appears as a witness.

Episodes.Title: The Effects Love and Breakups Have on the Brain
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru's statement in court stirs up the media. When he unravels the cause of Kim Mo-ran’s hypersexuality, Myeong-se and So-jeong get tangled up in it.

Episodes.Title: A Teenage Brain Versus A Psychopath Brain
Episodes.Description: A bleeding boy is found unconscious in I-na's bedroom. All of her friends claim she's the one responsible, and unfortunately, the evidence agrees.

Episodes.Title: The Best Revenge
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru helps prove I-na's innocence. As he and Myeong-se's family bond, Ha-ru finally discovers Myeong-se’s flaw, leading to his untimely resignation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ha-ru learns that his parents weren't killed in a car accident but murdered. To find their killer, Ha-ru must accept a psychopath's dangerous offer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Myeong-se and Ha-ru must play the sympathy game, or else. The hostages will be released if their brain waves sync. Can two heads work better than one?

Entries.Title: Agency
Entries.Description: Determined to succeed amid rampant internal politics, Go Ah-in competes for a chance at a promotion. Meanwhile, Jung Jae-hun presents her with an offer.

Episodes.Title: A Swan Incessantly Kicks Its Legs Beneath the Surface
Episodes.Description: Determined to succeed amid rampant internal politics, Go Ah-in competes for a chance at a promotion. Meanwhile, Jung Jae-hun presents her with an offer.

Episodes.Title: Think Strategically and Act Crazy
Episodes.Description: Kang Han-na returns to Korea after cluing in to the path that's laid for her. Ah-in discovers the harsh truth about her job — sending her into a spiral.

Episodes.Title: When a Lion Begins the Hunt, the Jungle Trembles in Fear
Episodes.Description: Ah-in's strategic move riles up the staff at the agency. Later, she makes a controversial executive decision — and a risky bet.

Episodes.Title: Shared Joy Becomes Jealousy, Shared Sorrow Becomes a Weakness
Episodes.Description: With her job on the line, Ah-in must scramble when a big client faces legal trouble. She later meets Han-na, who begins working at her company.

Episodes.Title: A Candle Shines Brighter Than the Sun At Night
Episodes.Description: Cho Eun‑jeong approaches Ah-in after struggling to balance work and family life. As part of a strategic move, Ah-in offers Han-na an enticing proposal.

Episodes.Title: Make Sure to Listen Even to a Fool
Episodes.Description: Han-na's first press opportunity doesn't go as planned. Eun‑jeong witnesses Ah-in in a vulnerable moment. Later, Ah-in takes on a challenging PR project.

Episodes.Title: The Hungry Beast Will Get Fed
Episodes.Description: Poised to impress her father and prove him wrong, Han-na goes all in on the agency's PR pitch — pitting Ah-in and Choi Chang-su against each other.

Episodes.Title: Well-Prepared Villains Are Quick to Act
Episodes.Description: Ah-in discovers the true intention behind the PR project. She and her team scramble to concoct the perfect messaging for their upcoming pitch.

Episodes.Title: The Ones Who Make Miracles
Episodes.Description: Ah-in makes a defiant move and showcases her long-awaited presentation to Woowon Group. Han-na attempts to establish her authority at the agency.

Episodes.Title: The Check Always Comes
Episodes.Description: Ah-in finds herself in a precarious situation as her personal demons begin to weigh her down. Han-na makes a sudden proposition to Park Yeong-woo.

Episodes.Title: The Hour Between Dog and Wolf
Episodes.Description: Chang-su continues his attempts to stir up the company's internal politics — and raise his own stature. Ah-in receives a threat after her latest success.

Episodes.Title: Forgetting What Was Lost
Episodes.Description: Han-na shares a tender moment with her father — who gives her some unexpected advice. Ah-in comes face-to-face with a figure from the past.

Episodes.Title: Only Those You Trust Can Stab You in the Back
Episodes.Description: Kang Han-su approaches Yeong-woo with an offer. Ah-in lets her guard down and makes kind gestures to her team. Chang-su schemes to take down Ah-in.

Episodes.Title: The War Only Ends for the Deceased
Episodes.Description: Chang-su escalates his attacks against Ah-in and Han-na — who later work together when a sudden dilemma arises. Ah-in makes an abrupt career move.

Episodes.Title: What You Shouldn't Do, and What You Need to Do
Episodes.Description: An unexpected person steps in to advocate for Ah-in, angering Chang-su. Ah-in offers Han-na guidance on her next steps — no strings attached.

Episodes.Title: You Must Row the Boat and Move Forward When There Is No Wind
Episodes.Description: A bombshell revelation puts an unwanted spotlight on Chang-su. Ah-in and Han-na set their final plan into motion to rise to the top of the company.

Entries.Title: The Elegant Empire
Entries.Description: During the commemoration of Jang Chang Sung's first anniversary memorial service, Jang Gi Yun embarks on the expansion strategy for the company he inherited. This move involves E promoting the two-billion-dollar business centered around VK Media Culture Valley. At this juncture, Seo Hee Jae emerges at WJ Entertainment, sparking Gi Yun's curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Borrow You For A Moment
Episodes.Description: During the commemoration of Jang Chang Sung's first anniversary memorial service, Jang Gi Yun embarks on the expansion strategy for the company he inherited. This move involves E promoting the two-billion-dollar business centered around VK Media Culture Valley. At this juncture, Seo Hee Jae emerges at WJ Entertainment, sparking Gi Yun's curiosity.

Episodes.Title: Look Who's Here
Episodes.Description: Two imposing men are pursuing Hee Jae, and it's at this moment that she crosses paths E with Gi Yun. Her demeanor and conversation immediately capture Gi Yun's attention. Back at NA Entertainment, Hee Jae has personal justifications for her decision to stay and engage. The team at NA Entertainment insists on her showcasing her skills. With no hesitation, she storms into WJ Entertainment to resolve matters promptly.

Episodes.Title: A Photo of Gi Yun and Hee Jae
Episodes.Description: Seung Pil takes a picture of Gi Yun and Hee Jae together at a bar and sends it to Jacklyn to get her infuriated. Jacklyn recognizes Hee Jae right away as she looks exactly like Ju Kyung. Woo Hyuk advises Hee Jae to stay away from Gi Yun, while Jacklyn visits Gi Yun at his office the next day and runs into Hee Jae again.

Episodes.Title: The New Model for Miyu Cosmetics
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae manages to make Hyunta the new model of Miyu Cosmetics just before Na Hee's contract renewal. Gi Yun and Jacklyn lose control when they lose the deal to NA Entertainment. Therefore, Gi Yun comes up with another plan to persuade the CEO of Miyu Cosmetics. Meanwhile, Gi Yun discovers something interesting while investigating Hee Jae's family background.

Episodes.Title: Your Man A Breeze for Me
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk is unable to move on from his feelings for Ju Kyung, and encountering Hee Jae, who bears a striking resemblance to Ju Kyung, only adds to his confusion. During a visit to Gi Yun's house to resolve unresolved matters, Hee Jae accidentally pours wine on herself. This results in her reluctantly borrowing one of Jaclyn's dresses, only to be caught off guard by Jaclyn's sudden intrusion.

Episodes.Title: Forgiveness
Episodes.Description: Seeing Soo A in Gi Yun's residence triggers memories of the days Hee Jae spent as Shin Ju Kyung. A decade ago, Chairman Jang held unfavorable opinions about Gi Yun and desired Ju Kyung to be his spouse, hoping she would guide him on the correct path. Faced with numerous significant blunders, Gi Yun found himself compelled to wed Ju Kyung solely to outwardly fulfill his father's desires.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Regret
Episodes.Description: After marrying Gi Yun, Ju Kyung gives birth to a daughter named Soo A and is living happily. Ju Kyung picks up Gi Yun, who has returned from a business trip abroad. Coincidentally, Seung Pil is there, and he introduces Jaclyn, who had caught Gi Yun's attention during his trip. Gi Yun finds it difficult to suppress his feelings for Jaclyn.

Episodes.Title: Dangerous Woman
Episodes.Description: Seung Pil decides to get his revenge on Gi Yun for his time in prison. He plots with wealthy Jaclyn to steal Gi Yun's company. However, when Gi Yun and Jaclyn cross paths at a hotel bar, it sparks mutual interest between the two of them.

Episodes.Title: Win Over Jaclyn's Interest
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun confronts Jaclyn during her inaugural ceremony and successfully feigns condescension to capture her attention. Meanwhile, Assemblyman Yang Hee Chan strategically attracts Jaclyn to Gi Yun's new project as part of a plan to secure Jaclyn's investment.

Episodes.Title: Chairman Jang Gi Yun
Episodes.Description: Upon hearing Ju Kyung's assurance that she intended to make him the next chairman and fully support him, Gi Yun had confidence in her words. However, the announcement during the commemoration event catches both Gi Yun and Ju Kyung off guard, resulting in a profound shock.

Episodes.Title: Jang Gi Yun Belongs Here
Episodes.Description: The astonishing declaration of the new chairman catches Gi Yun off guard, pushing him to rely solely on Jaclyn. To win her favor, he strategizes to fulfill her every wish, showing a willingness to cross boundaries with Ju Kyung. While attending a hotel meeting, Ju Kyung is confronted with Gi Yun and Jaclyn's shameless demeanor, placing her in an uncomfortable position.

Episodes.Title: Ju Kyung Begs Gi Yun to Come Home
Episodes.Description: Ju Kyung tries her best to persuade Gi Yun at the hotel where he and Jaclyn are together to come home. However, Gi Yun doesn't want to leave Jaclyn. Ju Kyung tells Hye Rim about Gi Yun's affair, but ironically, Hye Rim takes Jaclyn's side. Ju Kyung has no choice but to expose everything to Chairman Jang, causing Chairman Jang to call Gi Yun and Jaclyn to his house.

Episodes.Title: Gi Yuns Trap
Episodes.Description: Ju Kyung tells Chairman Jang that Gi Yun had used company assets as collateral to get an immense loan. Gi Yun senses danger after getting rebuked intensely by Chairman Jang and plots to bring Ju Kyung down from her position in the company. Meanwhile, Ju Kyung falls into Gi Yun's trap and gets taken away by the police for embezzlement.

Episodes.Title: Ju Kyung Gets Arrested
Episodes.Description: After Chairman Jang learns Ju Kyung was arrested by the police unfairly at the hands of Gi Yun, he angrily demands Gi Yun to get her released immediately. Gi Yun can't take his father's words anymore, and he decides to get rid of him by secretly giving him an overdose of his medicine. As Chairman Jang suffers in pain, Ju Kyung walks into his room.

Episodes.Title: An Ambitious Evil
Episodes.Description: At Chairman Jang's funeral, Ju Kyung is apprehended on allegations of murdering him. Due to Gi Yun's interference, every attorney declines to represent Ju Kyung. Adding to the adversity, Hye Rim provides false testimony, claiming she saw Ju Kyung commit the murder. Overwhelmed by shock, Ju Kyung collapses and bleeds.

Episodes.Title: Divorce Papers
Episodes.Description: Having already experienced a miscarriage, Ju Kyung now faces an impending prison term due to false murder charges. What makes it even more agonizing is her inability to be with Soo A. Gi Yun views this as a chance to pressure her into signing divorce papers, although his true motives are concealed. In the confines of prison, Ju Kyung weighs her remaining choices.

Episodes.Title: She Will Never Return
Episodes.Description: With Jaclyn now wedded to Gi Yun following Ju Kyung's imprisonment, her current objective is to eliminate Woo Hyuk. Their actions have not only snuffed out Woo Hyuk's chance to thrive as an actor but also compelled him to perform menial tasks around the office. Amidst it all, Woo Hyuk endures the humiliation, eagerly anticipating Ju Kyung's return.

Episodes.Title: The Anonymous Text
Episodes.Description: Ye Kyung searches for evidence frantically to prove Ju Kyung's innocence, while Gi Yun and Jaclyn consider Yu Kyung to be a thorn in their sides. One day, Ye Kyung leaves to retrieve evidence proving Ju Kyung's innocence after receiving an anonymous text message from someone claiming to have it. But she sustains a deadly fall in a parking elevator shaft and gets rushed to the hospital.

Episodes.Title: Gi Yun and Jaclyn Visit Ju Kyung
Episodes.Description: Although Ye Kyung survives the horrible accident, she seriously injures her leg. Woo Hyuk believes the accident was not a coincidence. Meanwhile, Gi Yun and Jaclyn visit Ju Kyung in prison to tell her that Soo A can't remember her and is having a hard time because of her. Tormented by their words, Ju Kyung tries to take her life.

Episodes.Title: A Restraining Order
Episodes.Description: Ju Kyung makes the firm choice to dedicate herself to Soo A's well-being once she's released from prison. On the day of her release, she anxiously watches Soo A from a distance, as a restraining order prevents her from getting closer, and is taken aback when her daughter passes by without recognizing her. Ju Kyung is certain that Soo A is not being cared for with love.

Episodes.Title: Ju Kyung Needs to Do Something
Episodes.Description: The distressing fact that Soo A could be in harm's way due to Gi Yun and Jaclyn terrifies Ju Kyung. Worried about Soo A's well-being, Ju Kyung anxiously monitors the kindergarten pickup, but nobody shows up, allowing her a chance to bond with her daughter. However, Gi Yun soon discovers this and manipulates the situation to his advantage.

Episodes.Title: I'll Crash You
Episodes.Description: After parting ways with her colleagues at NA Entertainment for Soo A's sake, Ju Kyung finds herself in a month's time facing Gi Yun's refusal to honor their agreement, mocking her innocence. It dawns on Ju Kyung that she's fallen for Gi Yun's deception once more, prompting her to take action in retaliation.

Episodes.Title: Woo Hyuk Leaves Home
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk gets caught for wanting to become an actor by Jun Hee. He decides to leave his family to continue to become one. With nowhere to go, he heads to NA Entertainment. Meanwhile, after watching Seung Pil leave his seat to answer Jaclyn's phone call, he becomes suspicious of him.

Episodes.Title: Soo A Recognizes Ju Kyung
Episodes.Description: While half asleep, Soo A recognizes her mother's face. She leaves the hospital alone and heads to the address she remembers from Woo Hyuk. Meanwhile, Jaclyn leaves the house after fighting with Gi Yun and goes to Seung Pil's house to make Gi Yun jealous. However, when she gets there, she sees Soo A.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn's Love
Episodes.Description: Upon hearing that Gi Yun wants to reunite with Ju Kyung, Jaclyn is shocked, and jealousy begins to take root within her. At the same time, Woo Hyuk acknowledges his love for Ju Kyung and decides to confess his feelings. Ju Kyung herself begins to harbor similar feelings, and Woo Hyuk's confession moves her. However, their blossoming relationship doesn't go unnoticed by Gi Yun, who devises a plan to disrupt it in the most unpleasant manner.

Episodes.Title: Gi Yun Fails
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun's plan to drive a wedge between Ju Kyung and Woo Hyuk backfires, leaving him anxious about the potential leverage she may have. He urgently hunts for Chang Sung's hearing aid, suspecting it may house a hidden camera with incriminating content that could corner him. His extreme distress compels him to concentrate solely on recovering the missing hearing aid.

Episodes.Title: This Is All On You
Episodes.Description: In a heartbreaking moment, Ju Kyung must bear witness as her beloved Ye Kyung's life is taken away in a tragic car accident, leaving her in a state of utter despair. Her tears fall, a turbulent mix of sadness and fury. Later, at the funeral, she uncovers the disturbing truth that Gi Yun is the one behind this tragedy and swears to seek vengeance. The first step in her plan involves faking her own death in place of Ye Kyung's.

Episodes.Title: Yu Kyung Returns As Hee Jae
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae appears after completely wiping out Shin Ju Kyung's past. Finally, with Seung Pil's help, she gets to unsheathe her blade in revenge against Jang Gi Yun. Meanwhile, Gi Yun becomes captivated by Hee Jae's provocative charms without having the slightest clue that she is the late Shin Ju Kyung, and Jaclyn, who has to witness it, becomes infuriated.
