Episodes.Title: A Smile Of Satisfaction
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn and Gi Yun keep getting into fights with Hee Jae in the picture, and Hee Jae watches them with a smile of satisfaction. Meanwhile, Woo Hyuk visits Yu Kyung's niche and confides in her about the confusion over Hee Jae, and Hee Jae takes Jun Hee to the hospital for suddenly collapsing.

Episodes.Title: First on the List
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae picks Jaclyn as her primary focus, and the situation already begins to lean in her favor when she brings Gi Yun home, who is almost passed out from excessive drinking. Later, Gi Yun shares with Hye Rim his feelings for Hee Jae, who bears an uncanny resemblance to Ju Kyung. Meanwhile, Woo Hyuk stumbles upon the revelation that Hee Jae is actually Ju Kyung herself, the person he has pined for.

Episodes.Title: Sorry I Didn't Recognize You Earlier
Episodes.Description: Once Woo Hyuk uncovers her identity, Hee Jae opts to inform him about her true self while keeping her pursuit of Gi Yun a secret. As WJ Entertainment marks its foundation day, Gi Yun invites Hee Jae to his home. At the same time, Hee Jae begins implementing her strategy to intercept Jaclyn's money before it arrives in Gi Yun's hands.

Episodes.Title: Payback
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun gets drunk and looks at his father's picture in deep remorse. Hye Rim falls to the floor when she hears Gi Yun tell her that he knows about the secret of his birth. Meanwhile, Hee Jae's heart breaks when she realizes she can't tell Soo A she is her mother.

Episodes.Title: Not Sleeping Together
Episodes.Description: Hye Rim is thrown off by the surprising fact that Gi Yun and Jaclyn aren't sharing a bedroom. Things get spicy at NA Entertainment as Jaclyn spills the tea on Hee Jae and Gi Yun's secret relationship. Woo Hyuk wears a look of disbelief when he hears about Hee Jae's deep connection with Gi Yun, but his trust in her is unshaken, standing strong against any fleeting doubts.

Episodes.Title: Forbidden Love
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun openly expresses his love to Hee Jae but swiftly concludes their romance as it clashes with societal norms. In the meantime, Jaclyn delves into the background of Suzuki Yamato, believed to be Hee Jae's father, uncovering his fictitious existence. Recognizing this as her singular opportunity, she endeavors to permanently eliminate Hee Jae from her life.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn Plans To Expose Hee Jae
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk is surprised when he learns Jun Hee is the chairwoman at Jung Capital, where Soo Ho works. Meanwhile, Hye Rim guides Dr. Oh secretly down to the basement, and Jaclyn asks Hee Jae to come and be the translator for a meeting she has with a Japanese investor.

Episodes.Title: Suzuki Yamato Appears
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn slides over an envelope full of money to a man impersonating Suzuki Yamato to get him to testify that he isn't Hee Jae's father. Meanwhile, Hee Jae returns an expensive necklace to Gi Yun that he secretly gave her, and Jaclyn finds it in Gi Yun's desk drawer.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn's Plan Utterly Fails
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn's face turns red with embarrassment when Suzuki says the opposite of what he promised to expose in front of Gi Yun. When asked about the money he had borrowed for Woo Hyuk, Soo Ho can't say a word. Meanwhile, Hee Jae worries that Woo Hyuk will get hurt because of her.

Episodes.Title: A Mere Stepmother
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae notices that Soo A naturally gravitates toward her when she picks her up from kindergarten, and Jaclyn is powerless to prevent Hee Jae, the biological mother, from assuming that maternal role. Gi Yun feels a sense of comfort seeing his daughter's happiness with Hee Jae. Meanwhile, Gi Yun believes it's only fair to remove Jaclyn from the picture and welcome Hee Jae into his life.

Episodes.Title: Penniless Jaclyn
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn finds herself with nothing after falling victim to a scam, and now she fears that Gi Yun might leave her, seeing no value in her. She strongly suspects Hee Jae orchestrated the scam but lacks evidence. Determined to secure funds, she resorts to any means necessary, ultimately arriving at Jung Capital, where a familiar face awaits her.

Episodes.Title: Hee Jae Makes Her Move
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae wins Gi Yun's favor when she hands him a large sum of money after seeing him broke and looking for a solution. Gi Yun accepts her offer and falls even harder for her. Meanwhile, one step at a time, Hee Jae gets closer to her revenge and watches Gi Yun become more anxious.

Episodes.Title: Hee Jae Leaves Woo Hyuk
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae can't stand the thought of leaving Soo A alone with Jaclyn, who abuses her. She resolves to move in with Gi Yun for the time being. Hee Jae plans to move in with Gi Yun on Woo Hyuk's birthday after leaving Woo Hyuk a heart-breaking goodbye and kiss. Meanwhile, Gi Yun finds out the movie investment he had made with Hee Jae's money was a scam.

Episodes.Title: Hee Jae Moves In
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn devises a plan to destroy Hee Jae, who has now taken over the master bedroom she once shared with Gi Yun. One night, Jaclyn waits for Hee Jae to leave work in the basement parkade to kidnap her. Meanwhile, Woo Jae watches over Hee Jae on his phone through a GPS tracking application.

Episodes.Title: Woo Hyuk Saves Hee Jae
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn believes she perfectly destroyed the evidence of her crime and leaves the scene. Woo Hyuk saves Hee Jae from the fire, and Hee Jae loses consciousness. Meanwhile, Gi Yun is worried about Hee Jae as she has not returned home.

Episodes.Title: Divorce Me Not Happening
Episodes.Description: After surviving an almost fatal encounter with Jaclyn, Hee Jae opts to leave the house. Weary of Jaclyn, Gi Yun contemplates divorce, but she derides his financial constraints. Gi Yun must strategize another way to eliminate Jaclyn for the well-being of Soo A and Hee Jae. Meanwhile, Hee Jae pities Woo Hyuk, fully aware of the impending end to their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn Visits Her Mother
Episodes.Description: After getting renounced by her mother-in-law, Hye Rim, Jaclyn has nowhere to go. She remembers the address of her mother's nursing home Seung Pil had given her, and she decides to go there. However, when she gets there, her mother doesn't remember her.

Episodes.Title: Evidence Of Attempted Murder
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn cries in pain as her mother, Sun Ja, cannot recognize her, and Seung Pil feels bad for both of them. Meanwhile, Hee Jae and Woo Hyuk plan to hand over the evidence of Jaclyn's attempted murder to Gi Yun, and Jun Hee finds out Hee Jae is living under a fake identity.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn Signs The Divorce Papers
Episodes.Description: Even though Gi Yun finds out about Jaclyn's attempted murder, she blames Ju Kyung for her crime and takes it out on her. Gi Yun gets infuriated at Jacklyn and wants to kick her out of his house immediately. Meanwhile, Hee Jae is disappointed in Seung Pil as she realizes he is on Jacklyn's side.

Episodes.Title: Chang Sung Wakes Up
Episodes.Description: Chang Sung miraculously gains consciousness after a year-long sleep, and Gi Yun calls Hye Rim immediately. They plan to soundproof Chang Sung's room secretly while Jaclyn is asleep. However, Seung Pil gets suspicious and barges into Gi Yun's house as he cannot reach Jaclyn.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Warning
Episodes.Description: Following Woo Hyuk's collapse, Gi Yun firmly warns him to stay away from Hee Jae, cautioning him about potential consequences if he continues to be a problem. This warning instead fuels Woo Hyuk's determination to protect Hee Jae from harm. Meanwhile, Woo Hyuk's mother calls Hee Jae, demanding truthful answers amidst the unfolding drama.

Episodes.Title: Gi Yun Makes Jaclyn Disappear
Episodes.Description: After being pushed into a corner by Jaclyn for her investment money, Gi Yun orders Sung Gu to kidnap Jaclyn and put her in a mental hospital. With Jaclyn, a thorn in his side, out of the picture, Gi Yun finally lets out a relieving sigh of satisfaction. Meanwhile, Hee Jae discloses her plan for revenge to Jun Hee and gains her support.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn Learns She is Pregnant
Episodes.Description: With Seung Pil's help, Jaclyn gets away from Sung Gu and makes it to the hospital. At the hospital, Jaclyn finds out she is pregnant and becomes happy about it. Jaclyn decides to have the baby whether Gi Yun accepts her or not. Later, she confidently goes to WJ Entertainment and discloses the good news in front of all the employees.

Episodes.Title: A Break, Not a Breakup
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae decides that, for revenge, it’s only right for her to move back into Gi Yun’s house. To execute her plan, she informs Woo Hyuk that she’s ending everything with him, and being well aware of her situation, he can't deny it. Hee Jae shares her plans with Woo Hyuk’s mother, hoping that they will comfort her. Caught in the dilemma, Woo Hyuk continues to emotionally struggle.

Episodes.Title: If Your Love Is True, Let Me Be
Episodes.Description: Upon realizing that Gi Yun has caught them sharing a goodbye kiss, Hee Jae forcefully distances herself from Woo Hyuk, leaving lasting emotional scars on him. Despite his discomfort with Hee Jae moving back in with Gi Yun, Woo Hyuk tries to empathize with her situation. In the meantime, Jun Hee is on her way to visit her son, and Hee Chan recognizes her.

Episodes.Title: Gi Yun and Jaclyn's Baby
Episodes.Description: After a chance encounter on the street, Hee Chan warns Jun Hee to maintain her current low profile, emphasizing that she should stay quiet. Jun Hee, in turn, makes it clear that there will be consequences if Hee Chan were to cause harm to her or her son. Meanwhile, Jaclyn exploits her pregnancy to reconcile with Gi Yun, who remains utterly indifferent. Hye Rim, however, holds a different perspective. Several days later at WJ, Hee Jae is witness to something repulsive in Gi Yun's office.

Episodes.Title: Hee Jae Risks Her Life
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk and Hee Jae learn that Gi Yun has been extorting landowners of their land for his casino business. Hee Jae puts her life on the line to rescue one of the landowners held by Gi Yun and almost exposes her identity. Meanwhile, Seung Pil changes his mind about leaving after encountering Gi Yun.

Episodes.Title: That's Impossible
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun realizes that an unidentified woman is hindering his progress, yet this doesn't deter him from committing atrocious acts. Meanwhile, all Woo Hyuk desires is the happiness of his loved ones, which include his mother and Hee Jae. Unfortunately, it will only be a matter of time before he finds out about his mother's illness. On the flip side, Jaclyn verifies her baby's gender and seeks ways to strengthen her position in Gi Yun's household.

Episodes.Title: Farewell Hee Jae
Episodes.Description: The news of his mother's illness plunges Woo Hyuk into deep emotional pain, leading him to prioritize her care. Jun Hee, recognizing her imminent fate, implores Woo Hyuk not to follow Hee Jae's vengeful path. Despite his enduring love for Hee Jae, Woo Hyuk decides it's time to let her go and focus on his mother's needs.

Episodes.Title: I'll Raise Your Baby
Episodes.Description: Quietly making her way into Gi Yun's home lobby, Jaclyn waits for Hee Jae and Soo A to come back. With Jaclyn laying bare the truth, Hee Jae discovers Jaclyn’s secret visits to Gi Yun’s home and her pregnancy with Gi Yun's child. Contrary to Jaclyn's expectations, Hee Jae calmly recommends that Jaclyn consider letting her raise the baby for the child's sake.

Episodes.Title: Hee Jae Stops Gi Yun and Hye Rim
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun and Hye Rim plan to send Chang Sung to an island to lock him up for eternity as he becomes increasingly a burden. However, when they drug Hee Jae to sleep and attempt to sneak Chang Sung out secretly, they are horrified when they hear her call out Chang Sung's name. Meanwhile, Bit Na runs away from home to Seung Pil's house.

Episodes.Title: Gi Yun Confronts Woo Hyuk
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun discovers that someone has been discreetly buying large amounts of WJ Entertainment's shares. Gi Yun worries that his company will fall into the hands of someone other than himself. He finds out that Woo Hyuk is the one who is buying the shares and then aggressively confronts him about it.

Episodes.Title: Secret Hangout
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun throws a fit at Woo Hyuk after finding out he is planning to dismiss him from his chairman position. Soo A secretly sneaks out of the house and meets Woo Hyuk without letting Hee Jae know. Meanwhile, Sung Il introduces Jun Hee to Hee Chan and Young Ran.

Episodes.Title: Woo Hyuk's Father
Episodes.Description: Jun Hee immediately breaks up with Sung Il after Hee Chan finds out she is Woo Hyuk's mother. Hee Chan runs a background check on Jun Hee to see if Woo Hyuk is his own son. Meanwhile, Hee Jae asks Gi Yun for permission to take a look at the company ledger.

Episodes.Title: Hye Rim's Bracelet
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn proudly flaunts the bracelet Hee Jae had given Hye Rim in front of Hee Jae. Worried about the wiretapping device in the bracelet, Hee Jae forcefully takes it from her. However, the bracelet breaks and Jaclyn sees the wiretapping device. Jaclyn finds it suspicious and tells Gi Yun about it right away.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn's Suspicions
Episodes.Description: After keeping a close eye on Hee Jae, Jaclyn questions Hee Jae's true identity. Later, Hee Jae commits to a DNA test between her and Soo A to shake off Jaclyn's suspicions. Meanwhile, Hee Jae, Gi Yun, Hye Rim, and Jaclyn wait together for the paternity test to arrive.

Episodes.Title: The Elegant Empire
Episodes.Description: Out of anger, Gi Yun takes away the dolls and toys with memories that Woo Hyuk had given Soo A and makes her cry. Seeing Soo A in tears, Hee Jae tells Woo Hyuk with a heavy heart to stay away from Soo A to preempt any further hardships for Soo A. Meanwhile, Woo Hyuk stumbles upon Hye Rim and his mother in a heated conversation.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn Enters The Basement
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk is shocked to find out that Hee Chan is his biological father. When Jun Hee explains what happened in the past to him, he decides to bring Hee Chan down to take revenge. Meanwhile, Hee Jae figures out where Gi Yun is hiding the ledger, and Jaclyn sneaks into the basement of Gi Yun's house.

Episodes.Title: A Video Clip From Stranger
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun and Hye Rim receive a video clip of Chang Sung from an anonymous caller, and Gi Yun hopes it is not Hee Jae who blackmailed them. Woo Hyuk warns Hee Chan to stop the casino business he is working on with Gi Yun. Meanwhile, Chang Sung tells Hee Jae to find the hearing aid he gave to Soo A.

Episodes.Title: Jaclyn Doesn't Back Down
Episodes.Description: Hye Rim learns that the baby Jaclyn is carrying isn't a boy. She calls Jaclyn over and interrogates her about her lies and deception. However, Jaclyn doesn't back down one bit. Meanwhile, Jaclyn lets Hye Rim and Gi Yun know that she knows Chang Sung is alive, pushing them into madness.

Episodes.Title: Hee Jae's New Plan
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn can't throw her suspicions of Hee Jae being Ju Kyung away and follows her. Hee Jae plans to use Jaclyn to expose to the world that Woo Hyuk is Hee Chan's love child and have it destroy his political career. She also plans to use Jaclyn to come between Hee Chan and Gi Yun and slowly demolish Gi Yun's life.

Episodes.Title: Gi Yun Locks Jaclyn
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun determines to dispose of Jaclyn, the thorn in his side. He takes her to a refrigerated container and locks her inside. Luckily, Hee Jae and Woo Hyuk save her from death. However, Jaclyn loses her baby, and she vows to get her revenge against Gi Yun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 71
Episodes.Description: Pressured by Woo Hyuk's threat, Hee Chan is forced to expose Gi Yun's every corruption to the public. Meanwhile, Hee Jae involves Jaclyn to bring down both Hee Chan and Gi Yun simultaneously. Upon discovering the potential connection between Woo Hyuk and Hee Chan, Gi Yun is eager to confirm the true nature of their relationship.

Episodes.Title: Episode 72
Episodes.Description: As the safe vanishes, Hee Jae frets anxiously, worried that Gi Yun may have caught on to her true intentions. Meanwhile, Jaclyn pays a visit to Hee Chan, aiming to lure him into backstabbing Gi Yun. Despite this, Gi Yun proves to be a step ahead of Hee Chan, pressuring him to prioritize what's best for his business, unless he wants to confront the inevitable public humiliation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 73
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun believes Hee Jae does not love him, and he questions why she approached him. Meanwhile, Hee Chan thinks deeply about hurting his son, Woo Hyuk. However, Gi Yun pressures him and puts Hee Chan in a tight spot, making him decide to end Woo Hyuk's life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 74
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk falls into despair after his mother dies from a hit-and-run accident that was supposed to be for him. Hee Chan sees Woo Hyuk in deep sadness and can't help but feel guilty. Meanwhile, Hee Jae rushes to Woo Hyuk's mother's funeral despite Gi Yun's strong disapproval.

Episodes.Title: Episode 75
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun provokes Woo Hyuk on purpose and then reports him to the police to keep him from the funeral. Jaclyn barges into Gi Yun's home for her revenge even though Seung Pil tries to stop her. Meanwhile, Hee Jae secretly goes back to Jun Hee's wake at night.

Episodes.Title: Episode 76
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun discovers that someone is aware of the home CCTV and has tampered with its configurations. This leads him to suspect that either Hee Jae or Jaclyn might be involved in the covert activity. In response, he instructs Sung Gu to thoroughly inspect the entire house for signs of monitoring, and he eventually stumbles upon an unusual device. Gi Yun's distrust of Hee Jae intensifies.

Episodes.Title: Episode 77
Episodes.Description: As Hee Jae's clandestine activities in the study come to light, Gi Yun takes proactive measures, initiating a surveillance plan to closely observe her actions. Simultaneously, Jaclyn, perceiving the imminent peril for Hee Jae, rushes to provide a timely warning. Meanwhile, Gi Yun successfully identifies the orchestrator of private detective work, shedding light on Hee Jae's deceptive maneuvers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 78
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk is willing to bend his standards to ensure the downfall of Yang Hee Chan, involving Bit Na in the process. Meanwhile, in her effort to aid Chang Sung's escape from the house, Jaclyn becomes trapped. Frustrated with Jaclyn's constant presence, Hye Rim decides to lock her up in a place of no return.

Episodes.Title: Episode 79
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun, who has always been suspicious of Hee Jae, finally learns through the medication Hee Jae was taking and genetic testing with Soo A that she is positively Shin Ju Kyung. He plans his next move and aims to take all the money Hee Jae has. Meanwhile, without knowing anything, Gi Yun fools Hee Jae into thinking he doesn't suspect her anymore, and Hee Jae gives him a large sum of money.

Episodes.Title: Episode 80
Episodes.Description: Bit Na falls victim to Gi Yun's scheme and collapses when she hears Woo Hyuk is her half-brother. Hee Chan is also stunned by Gi Yun's intentions and intends to fight back. Meanwhile, Gi Yun makes plans to leave Hee Chan as his partner.

Episodes.Title: Episode 81
Episodes.Description: Now that Gi Yun knows Hee Jae's real identity, he's strategizing a countermove with a plan to inflict profound and lasting pain. It kicks off with Gi Yun proposing to Hee Jae in front of Soo A. Although Hee Jae requests time to ponder the proposal, Gi Yun emphasizes that her hesitant stance could jeopardize everything. Observing the developments between Hee Jae and Gi Yun, Woo Hyuk distances himself from Hee Jae even more.

Episodes.Title: Episode 82
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun shares the truth about Hee Jae with Hye Rim, outlining the plans he has for her. The sheer audacity of the situation makes it difficult for Hye Rim to grasp. Meanwhile, Seung Pil leaves a letter for Woo Hyuk before rushing to assist Jaclyn in escaping the hospital. However, they find themselves at a dead end while trying to escape the building.

Episodes.Title: Episode 83
Episodes.Description: Seung Pil's mishap unites Jaclyn and Hee Jae, sparking a conversation about their future intentions. During this exchange, Jaclyn emphasizes her commitment to ensuring Gi Yun faces consequences. Simultaneously, Hee Jae frets over the possibility that Gi Yun has discovered her true identity and is eager to aid Chang Sung in his escape at the earliest opportunity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 84
Episodes.Description: Hee Chan tries to destroy Gi Yun for Woo Hyuk's well-being but to no avail. Knowing Hee Chan would betray him, Gi Yun exposes to the press about Hee Chan's crime and makes him go on the run. As Hee Chan avoids the police, he plans his revenge against Gi Yun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 85
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae is deeply shocked after discovering Gi Yun had known about her true identity all along. Jaclyn, who knows about Gi Yun's plan, warns Hee Jae to tread cautiously. With time caving in on her, Hee Jae plans to sneak Chang Sung out of the house and use him to expose Gi Yun's evil deeds.

Episodes.Title: Episode 86
Episodes.Description: The threat to Hee Jae's life escalates as Gi Yun becomes a danger, and Hee Jae discovers herself without assistance. However, an unforeseen development lands Hee Jae in the hospital, temporarily averting the life-threatening danger. Meanwhile, Woo Hyuk stands by Hee Jae's side in the hospital, and they address and clear up the misunderstandings. Hee Jae now plans to go back to Gi Yun's house to handle unfinished business.

Episodes.Title: Episode 87
Episodes.Description: Soo A is overjoyed and tears up upon realizing that Hee Jae is her mother. However, she is concerned that her mother might leave again. Witnessing Soo A's happiness at having her complete family, Hee Jae hesitates to proceed with her revenge for Soo A's sake. Woo Hyuk agrees that focusing on Soo A's well-being is the best course of action. Meanwhile, Hee Chan, who is on the run, intends to secretly meet with Gi Yun, unaware of Gi Yun's plan to eliminate him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 88
Episodes.Description: Despite her revenge plans, Hee Jae places Chang Sung's safety first. Nevertheless, Gi Yun, sensing the impending threat, acts proactively. When Hee Jae finally catches on, it seems too late, and her only shot at saving Chang Sung now hangs by a thread.

Episodes.Title: Episode 89
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun becomes a mess when he learns he lost Chang Sung to Hee Jae. He meets with Dr. Oh and plans to play the media to stop Chang Sung's interview. Meanwhile, Hee Chan secretly contacts his family and tells them his plans to turn himself in. However, Gi Yun interferes with Hee Chan's confession.

Episodes.Title: Episode 90
Episodes.Description: Although Hee Chan's hit-and-run accident was not fatal, Gi Yun still smiles in satisfaction. Gi Yun visits NA Entertainment's accommodation to take back Chang Sung, but he fails due to the people's strong dissuasion. Enraged by his failed endeavor, Gi Yun hones his blade of revenge even sharper.

Episodes.Title: Episode 91
Episodes.Description: The police arrest Gi Yun for instigating Hee Chan's murder. However, Gi Yun claims that Woo Hyuk manipulated the footage to frame him for the crime. Hee Jae and Woo Hyuk feel hopeless as Gi Yun slips away again. Meanwhile, Sung Il reveals the truth behind Gi Yun's birth to Hee Jae and plans to report to the media that Chang Sung is alive.

Episodes.Title: Episode 92
Episodes.Description: Hee Jae finds herself challenged to prove her innocence in the face of Gi Yun's bold actions. Attempting to vindicate herself, she presents a video of Chang Sung to the police, only to encounter unexpected obstacles orchestrated by Gi Yun. Both Gi Yun and Hye Rim can't help but contemplate how much simpler everything would be if Hee Jae were no longer in the picture.

Episodes.Title: Episode 93
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun attempts to frame Hee Jae for fraud, yet Woo Hyuk ensures she avoids arrest. Despite Gi Yun's efforts against Hee Jae, she is determined to return home solely for Soo A. Regardless of Gi Yun's threats, Hee Jae remains steadfast in staying by Soo A's side. Chang Sung, in his rational state, endeavors to reform Gi Yun, but the scars run too deep for healing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 94
Episodes.Description: Chang Sung makes a video for Gi Yun that allows Gi Yun to prove that the footage Hee Jae submitted before was fake. Gi Yun gladly accepts his father's gift and puts Hee Jae in a difficult position. Hee Jae gets a restraining order, and she finds herself torn away from Soo A.

Episodes.Title: Episode 95
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun becomes anxious, thinking that Hee Chan still has files on his corruption. Although Hye Rim is still on bad terms with Young Ran, she visits Young Ran in the hospital room where Hee Chan is recovering, using him as an excuse to visit. While Young Ran steps out for a moment, Hye Rim starts to look for Gi Yun's corruption files. However, Young Ran returns and catches her in the act.

Episodes.Title: Episode 96
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn, despite being the brain behind it all, feigns ignorance about Gi Yun's mother. Gi Yun is on the brink, with no idea how to handle his mother's disappearance. Concurrently, Soo A is battling panic disorder due to her inability to see Ju Kyung. Ju Kyung, aiming to put an end to the revenge, tries to get in touch with Sung Gu.

Episodes.Title: Episode 97
Episodes.Description: Noticing that Yang Hee Chan isn't following the script, Gi Yun instructs Sung Gu to eliminate Hee Jae and Woo Hyuk. Sung Gu is assured safety upon leaving the country, leading him to comply with Gi Yun's directives. Yet, he senses the importance of having a backup plan to safeguard himself.

Episodes.Title: Episode 98
Episodes.Description: Even after Yang Hee Chan's confession, Gi Yun skillfully turns the situation to his advantage. Hee Jae and Woo Hyuk struggle to bring Gi Yun down, and now Tak Sung Gu attempts to contact them with the intention of revealing Gi Yun's secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 99
Episodes.Description: Jaclyn quickly escapes the house when she learns Gi Yun is returning home with Hye Rim, whom she is responsible for locking up in the mental hospital. Meanwhile, Young Ran visits Hee Chan in prison and sees his caring heart for Woo Hyuk, and Ju Kyung gets her hands on Gi Yun's corruption files and plans to expose him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 100
Episodes.Description: Woo Hyuk and Hee Jae head to the prosecution office to turn in Gi Yun's corruption ledger. However, Gi Yun lets them know about Soo A being diagnosed with leukemia to get away with his crimes. Gi Yun asks Hee Jae to hand over the ledger back to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun is singularly fixated on ensuring Hee Jae faces consequences for the embarrassment he endured, subsequently forging ahead with VK Media Valley's groundbreaking ceremony after falsely raising the hopes of his employees. Adding to the complexity, he intrudes into Woo Hyuk's residence to retrieve Soo A, whom Hee Jae had taken earlier.

Episodes.Title: Episode 102
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun confronts a challenging situation upon discovering a video depicting him mistreating his father. Skillfully evading the scenario, he endeavors to sway public opinion in his favor. Meanwhile, Hee Jae, faced with heightened challenges in executing her plans, readies herself anew to seek revenge, starting with a press conference.

Episodes.Title: Episode 103
Episodes.Description: Gi Yun reminds Prosecutor Yoo that he will take control of the country with VK Media's business and sways him to lock up Hee Jae, Woo Hyuk, and Jaclyn before the historic signing event. Meanwhile, Jaclyn is overwhelmed by Seung Pil's sudden death, and in anger, she points a gun at him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 104
Episodes.Description: After suffering a fatal blow from Hee Jae's entourage, Gi Yun looks to flee overseas with Hye Rim and Soo A. Meanwhile, everyone at WJ Entertainment and the people around Gi Yun finally see Gi Yun's true colors. As Gi Yun tries to escape, Hee Jae, Woo Hyuk, and Jaclyn chase him from behind.

Episodes.Title: Episode 105
Episodes.Description: After getting revenge on Gi Yun, Hee Jae reclaims her name and position and begins living a happy life with Soo A. Jaclyn recalls her memories of Seung Pil and starts a new life with her mother in the US. Meanwhile, Woo Hyuk plans an unforgettable marriage proposal to Ju Kyung.

Entries.Title: The Real Has Come!
Entries.Description: A great job and a great boyfriend; Yeon-doo has it all — until she finds Jun-ha cheating on her. Tae-kyeong rejects marriage and also his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: The Star Lecturer
Episodes.Description: A great job and a great boyfriend; Yeon-doo has it all — until she finds Jun-ha cheating on her. Tae-kyeong rejects marriage and also his girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Geum-sil's Scheme
Episodes.Description: Crushed to learn that she’s pregnant with Jun-ha's child, Yeon-doo seeks the help of the OB/GYN Tae-kyeong. Meanwhile, Geum-sil gives an ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: Yeon-doo's Dark Future
Episodes.Description: In-ok flees home from her conflicted son and mother-in-law. Se-jin tries to win Tae-kyeong over. Yeon-doo thinks her pregnancy might end her career.

Episodes.Title: A Mother's Love
Episodes.Description: The family learns about the pregnancy, but Bong-nim is still in the dark. Yeon-doo can't decide. Tae-kyeong makes peace, but In-ok wants a divorce.

Episodes.Title: Se Jin And Yeon Doo
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo's evicted when she reveals her intent to give birth. Tae-kyeong's ready to tie the knot. With family on her tail, Yeon-doo asks for his help.

Episodes.Title: The Father Of The Child
Episodes.Description: Tae-kyeong is convinced the wedding was a mistake. After Se-jin's lies, he tries to break things off. Yeon-doo runs into her mother at the Old School.

Episodes.Title: I'm The Baby's Father!
Episodes.Description: A shocked Bong-nim pressures Yeon-doo to get married, but neither the truth nor the wedding can be forced. Tae-kyeong runs into unexpected obstacles.

Episodes.Title: The Wedding Ceremony
Episodes.Description: Tae-kyeong evades Bong-nim's surprise visit and offers a marriage contract to Yeon-doo. His wedding to Se-jin is approaching, and so is the truth.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Doo’s Sabotage
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo's presence at the wedding causes chaos. She and Tae-kyeong agree to be a couple for their own purposes. Se-jin finds out who ruined it all.

Episodes.Title: The Marriage Certificate
Episodes.Description: Se-jin disrupts Yeon-doo and Tae-kyeong's engagement, but the mothers are steadfast. To speed things up, the couple may need to make things official.

Episodes.Title: The Memorial Service
Episodes.Description: The newlyweds lay low at Geum-sil's. But between Su-jeong and the memorial, Yeon-doo is stretched too thin... and Tae-kyeong doesn't understand why.

Episodes.Title: The Unwelcome Guest
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo and Tae-kyeong run into Se-jin. Hyun-woo is conflicted over Ji-myeong's pregnancy. And a final goodbye leads Se-jin to unexpected places.

Episodes.Title: Yeon-doo’s Birthday
Episodes.Description: Despite suspicions, Se-jin prepares to leave. Yeon-doo argues with Geum-sil while eating for two. Tae-kyeong gets an invite. Dong-wook sees Yu-myeong.

Episodes.Title: Se-jin’s Scheme
Episodes.Description: Determined and armed with a plan, Se-jin returns to tear apart the fake couple. Yeon-doo is nostalgic for her lecturing days and makes a pit stop.

Episodes.Title: Couvade Syndrome
Episodes.Description: Se-jin finally gains leverage on Yeon-doo and Tae-kyeong with her lies. Su-jeong sparks Geum-sil's suspicions about Yeon-doo and her truth.

Episodes.Title: Geum-sil's Deepest Secret
Episodes.Description: Geum-sil is nervous. Bong-nim has discovered her secret, one that the couple can't know. Yeon-doo worries about single motherhood at Bong-nim's house.

Episodes.Title: Becoming Friends
Episodes.Description: The couple braces themselves, but a power outage shakes things up at Geum-sil's. Hyun-woo swings by Ji-myeong's office but finds her with Sang-hoon.

Episodes.Title: Tae Kyung’s Heart
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo prepares for life on her own while Tae-kyeong baffles her with his glum attitude. Se-jin takes the opportunity to come between the couple.

Episodes.Title: Fighting Back
Episodes.Description: Dividing the company has Geum-sil and Cheon-myeong on edge. Yeon-doo helps Tae-kyeong escape them but feels lonely in his absence and wary of Se-jin.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Doo Turns Back
Episodes.Description: Tae-kyeong wants to break the contract. Unaware of his real feelings, Yeon-doo steels herself for their final farewell — until the unexpected happens.

Episodes.Title: Tae Kyung Expresses How He Feels
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo pushes Tae-kyeong away. A clearheaded Se-jin contacts Jun-ha. Ji-myeong and Hyun-woo's misunderstanding leads to a contract of their own.

Episodes.Title: Yeon Doo Looks For A New Place
Episodes.Description: Jun-ha's call is overdue. Tae-kyeong gives Se-jin the cold shoulder. Yeon-doo decides to move out, but Tae-kyeong wants their time together to last.

Episodes.Title: Don’t Trust Jang Se Jin
Episodes.Description: With 2 months left, Yeon-doo helps Tae-kyeong and his family reconcile. Se-jin is cornered after Chan-sik receives a letter. Jun-ha finally shows up.

Episodes.Title: The Emergency Patient
Episodes.Description: Tae-kyeong wants to keep sharing rooms like a real couple. Yeon-doo helps Geum-sil run for class president. Chan-sik is skeptical of Jun-ha's request.

Episodes.Title: Unwelcome Encounter
Episodes.Description: Jun-ha invites Tae-kyeong to golf after Yeon-doo's chilly reception. Hyun-woo and Mi-yeon are seen together. Se-jin finds who stabbed her in the back.

Episodes.Title: This Is the Real Me
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo fully commits to Geum-sil's campaign. Tae-kyeong forces her to take a break. But the break's over for Se-jin, and Jun-ha drops a bombshell.

Episodes.Title: Growing Worries
Episodes.Description: The big move draws near after the realtor's call. Yeon-doo feels for Tae-kyeong. In-ok is shocked at Sang-hoon's audacity. Chan-sik must make a deal.

Episodes.Title: The Real Dad
Episodes.Description: A chance meeting at the art museum tests Se-jin and Jun-ha's acting prowess. Tae-kyeong has complex feelings while watching Yeon-doo talk to her baby.

Episodes.Title: Do You Have Anything to Tell Me ?
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo helps Tae-kyeong talk to Geum-sil. A confused Chan-sik is swept up in Se-jin and Jun-ha's scheme. Ji-myeong and Hyun-woo explain themselves.

Episodes.Title: The Real Confession
Episodes.Description: Chan-sik's enraged over the truth, and Tae-kyeong intends to move out. Ji-myeong has something to tell Hyun-woo. Jun-ha finally learns the real story.

Episodes.Title: I Can’t Live without Yeon Doo
Episodes.Description: Tae-kyeong and Jun-ha rush an unconscious Yeon-doo to the hospital. Tae-kyeong leaves a gift for her. Jun-ha finally learns how the two first met.

Episodes.Title: Where Are You, Grandma ?
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo and "Real" get a warm welcome home from the family, but she feels conflicted. When Se-jin's plan tanks, she arranges Jun-ha to meet someone.

Episodes.Title: You Are No Longer Welcome Here
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo finally tells In-ok everything. Feeling betrayed and angry, In-ok casts Yeon-doo out to Bong-nim's house despite the couple's apologies.

Episodes.Title: You're Real
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo is gone. Tae-kyeong searches for her, but 5 months go by with no word. At last, Yeon-doo has the baby "Real" and decides to make a call.

Episodes.Title: Is It Really You ?
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo and Tae-kyeong have many questions for each other when they meet by chance. Su-jeong reports back to Geum-sil, who pays Tae-kyeong a visit.

Episodes.Title: You Always Run Away
Episodes.Description: Geum-sil finds Yeon-doo at Tae-kyeong's but keeps this fact to herself. Se-jin suspects Yeon-doo's return, but Yeon-doo vows to never return to Seoul.

Episodes.Title: I Will Not Run Away Anymore
Episodes.Description: She won't run anymore. Yeon-doo finally accepts her feelings for Tae-kyeong. Jun-ha takes advantage of Bong-nim's shock over the news of the couple.

Episodes.Title: How Far Will You Go ?
Episodes.Description: In-ok rushes to her son's house to confirm the rumors, upon which she gives an ultimatum. At Geum-sil's home, she gives the couple the cold shoulder.

Episodes.Title: In Ok’s Rage
Episodes.Description: In-ok will accept Yeon-doo if she gives up Ha-neul, but she won't. Tae-kyeong asks for Bong-nim's help. Geum-sil takes off after clashing with In-ok.

Episodes.Title: The Family Betrayal
Episodes.Description: The family finally shares their grievances. After, In-ok needs time alone, but Yeon-doo manages to find her. Dong-wook runs into Song-i at the café.

Episodes.Title: A Real Family
Episodes.Description: In-ok has a change of heart. The families gather to celebrate as Ha-neul makes a joyous debut. Tae-kyeong wants to make the marriage official.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Granddaughter
Episodes.Description: Jun-ha files a child custody suit. His cruel antics enrages Chan-sik, and a family meeting is arranged. Bong-nim reveals Se-jin's father to Yeon-doo.

Episodes.Title: No Way Out for Jun Ha
Episodes.Description: Chan-sik has Jun-ha in a corner. Tae-kyeong requests a DNA test between Geum-sil and his alleged aunt Echa. Se-jin quickly reports back to Jun-ha.

Episodes.Title: Geum Sil Accepts Joon Ha
Episodes.Description: Geum-sil meets Jun-ha at the memorial park. She can't help but care for him. The family warns Yeon-doo and Tae-kyeong about this change of heart.

Episodes.Title: For My Child
Episodes.Description: Neither Yeon-doo nor family can't stop Tae-kyeong from canceling the adoption. Amid the frenzy, Geum-sil bonds with Jun-ha as she prepares a memorial.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Leave
Episodes.Description: Jun-ha hides his DNA test results from all. Tae-kyeong decides to leave the country to protect his loved ones. Meanwhile, Echa pays a visit to Jun-ha.

Episodes.Title: Adopted Kid
Episodes.Description: In light of Tae-kyeong's past, Echa reveals that Jun-ha was adopted. Crushed, Geum-sil shuts out Jun-ha. Se-jin feels lost after her father collapses.

Episodes.Title: Uninvited Guest
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo and Tae-kyeong plan a family gathering, but Jun-ha gate-crashes. He wants to say goodbye to Ha-neul before leaving, but the couple is unsure.

Episodes.Title: Jun Ha Disappears
Episodes.Description: Jun-ha disappears with Ha-neul. Yeon-doo, Tae-kyeong and their families embark on a desperate search. Se-jin unknowingly bids farewell to her father.

Episodes.Title: New Family
Episodes.Description: Yeon-doo decides to move back. Tae-kyeong's family welcomes her and Ha-neul, but there's one thing left to do. Yu-myeong gives Dong-wook an ultimatum.

Entries.Title: Song of the Bandits
Entries.Description: Defying his master, Lee Yoon heads to North Gando to search for a man from his past — but danger from all sides proves to test his strength and vigilance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Defying his master, Lee Yoon heads to North Gando to search for a man from his past — but danger from all sides proves to test his strength and vigilance.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Nam Hee-shin leaves for the railroad ceremony to take part in a secret plan, but she faces several obstacles as hiccups occur and rivals take notice.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Lee Gwang-il brutally attempts to extract information from an independence fighter. As Yoon approaches Hee-shin, Eon-nyeoni provokes him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: As news of the railroad funds make the rounds, Yoon and his bandits come up against the Mounted Bandits. Hee-shin plans tricks of her own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yoon tracks down the railroad funds and encounters a frenzy. He later accompanies Hee-shin to complete her mission but comes upon another complication.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Choi Choong-soo questions Yoon's motives — realizing the truth may hurt their relationship. Eon-nyeoni gives Choong-soo a stern warning.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Eon-nyeoni hesitates in her mission, getting caught in the process. As forces come together to fight against Gwang-il, Hee-shin and Yoon part ways.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Yoon comes face to face with Gwang-il for a tense duel. Choong-soo and his bandits fight Jang Ki-ryong and his men — all for the safety of their town.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Choong-soo and his bandits face off against the town authorities. Gwang-il, Hee-shin and Yoon all discover the Japanese Army's true plans with Gando.

Entries.Title: Pandora: Beneath the Paradise
Entries.Description: Jae-hyun is touted as a presidential candidate after Hatch presentation. Tae-ra regains her memory.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Jae-hyun is touted as a presidential candidate after Hatch presentation. Tae-ra regains her memory.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Tae-ra cannot believe that she is No.50. At Hatch, Red gets murdered. Hae-soo meets an informant.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Jae-hyun declares his presidential candidacy and Kim Seon-deok appears. Tae-ra is troubled.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Hae-soo cannot accept that Tae-ra killed her father. Tae-ra chases the person who manipulated her life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Yu-ra is found dead, and Do-jin becomes a suspect. Hae-soo suggests Tae-ra appear on her talk show.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hae-soo reveals Tae-ra's identity on the talk show. Sung-chan finds an unexpected item and joins Tae-ra.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Tae-ra learns Pil-seung is her younger brother. Hae-soo and Do-jin discover Jae-hyun's suspicious past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Pil-seung confesses to assassinating President Ko Tae-sun, and Tae-ra tries to take the blame.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Kim Seon-deok dies in Tae-ra's hands at the banquet. Meanwhile, Hae-soo decides to reveal the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Tae-ra saves Hae-soo. The two finally face the truth about what happened fifteen years ago.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Jae-hyun cannot read Hae-soo's intentions. Tae-ra and Kyo-jin try to stop Hatch's second presentation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Tae-ra and Hae-soo cooperate in finding Jae-hyun's weakness before the second Hatch presentation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jae-hyun fabricates Tae-ra's memories by inserting a chip. Hae-soo and Kyo-jin try to bring her back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Tae-ra gets injured while saving Jae-hyun. The election starts, and the voting results are announced.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Jae-hyun gets away with a fire incident and spurs the inauguration ceremony of the Transition Team.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Jae-hyun searches for Tae-ra, but she is now with Kyo-jin. Everyone treats Jae-hyun like a lunatic.

Entries.Title: Revenant
Entries.Description: Folklorist Hae-sang warns San-yeong that she is possessed and that people around her will die.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Folklorist Hae-sang warns San-yeong that she is possessed and that people around her will die.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: San-yeong sees a ghost for the first time and eventually faces the evil spirit that possesses her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: San-yeong and Hae-sang arrive in the new city and witness a strange shadow of a tree.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: San-yeong and Hae-sang encounter unexpected things at Baekchagol Village.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: San-yeong hears a shocking story from Gyeong-mun. Hae-sang feels that Baekchagol Village has a secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Hae-sang takes the blue pottery to his grandmother, Byeong-hui, and San-yeong discovers old photos.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: San-yeong and Hae-sang are no longer able to trust each other. San-yeong looks into U-jin's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: San-yeong understands and sympathizes with Kang-mo's decision, while Hae-sang falls into despair.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The evil spirit's murder makes San-yeong and Hae-sang question its true identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: San-yeong and Hae-sang chase after the remaining two items to identify the evil spirit's real name.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Only one item remains to get rid of the evil spirit. The spirit tries to stop them by all means.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: San-yeong's shadow returns to its original state and Hae-sang realizes that something is wrong.

Entries.Title: Like Flowers in Sand
Entries.Description: Feeling despondent about his footing in the ssireum world, Kim Baek-du competes in a new tournament — coming up against a formidable opponent.

Episodes.Title: Ssireum Prodigy, Kim Baek-du
Episodes.Description: Feeling despondent about his footing in the ssireum world, Kim Baek-du competes in a new tournament — coming up against a formidable opponent.

Episodes.Title: There's Something About Oh Du-sik
Episodes.Description: Baek-du encounters an old friend who persistently denies knowing him. But he later sees her become the manager of his team and deduces her identity.

Episodes.Title: Du-sik Is Not Her Name
Episodes.Description: No longer a wrestler, Baek-du contemplates other career paths. After the coach suddenly quits the team, Oh Yu-gyeong tries to get to the bottom of it.

Episodes.Title: I Know What You Did That Day
Episodes.Description: Kwak Jin-su challenges Baek-du to a ssireum match for the role of coach. But the match is interrupted when the police take Baek-du away for questioning.

Episodes.Title: Kim Baek-du, I See Right Through You
Episodes.Description: After finding out Yu-gyeong's ruse, Baek-du rejoins the ssireum team. They later pay a visit to Lim Dong-seok to investigate the former coach.

Episodes.Title: What Cannot Be Hidden
Episodes.Description: Amid the ongoing investigation, Baek-du trains for an upcoming match. But when Jin-su suddenly sidelines Baek-du, Yu-gyeong stands up for him.

Episodes.Title: New Day, New Incident
Episodes.Description: Baek-du experiences several roadblocks as he tries to make his upcoming competition — and during his matches, he can't stop thinking about Yu-gyeong.

Episodes.Title: Remember, Don't Remember
Episodes.Description: After 20 years, Yu-gyeong meets with Joo Mi-ran to talk through unsolved business. While drunkenly catching up with Yu-gyeong, Baek-du makes a move.

Episodes.Title: All That We Have Lost
Episodes.Description: Ready to share more information, Mi-ran pays a visit to Yu-gyeong and Baek-du. Rumors of a scandal between Yu-gyeong and Baek-du circulate around town.

Episodes.Title: Endlessly Tangled, Persistently Intertwined
Episodes.Description: Baek-du awaits Yu-gyeong's response after a momentous confession. Meanwhile, several old friends begin to figure out Yu-gyeong's true identity.

Episodes.Title: The Culprit Lives Among Us
Episodes.Description: Old friends join forces to find the culprit hiding in their town. But when they hit a standstill, Mi-ran sets herself up as bait — much to her risk.

Episodes.Title: Like Flowers in Sand
Episodes.Description: With Mi-ran in danger, Yu-gyeong races to save her. Baek-du gives it his all in the tournament — hoping a win will secure a spot in Yu-gyeong's heart.

Entries.Title: The Story of Park's Marriage Contract
Entries.Description: Yeon-woo, a noble family member in Joseon, secretly makes clothes and sells them to the market, which is against the code of conduct for noble women in conservative society. One day, she gets in danger of being caught and punished for her clothes being considered too bold and vulgar. Soon, she is almost forced to marry into another noble family without knowing or seeing her future husband. After the wedding ceremony, her husband shares one big secret.

Episodes.Title: Yeon-woo’s Secret Business
Episodes.Description: Yeon-woo, a noble family member in Joseon, secretly makes clothes and sells them to the market, which is against the code of conduct for noble women in conservative society. One day, she gets in danger of being caught and punished for her clothes being considered too bold and vulgar. Soon, she is almost forced to marry into another noble family without knowing or seeing her future husband. After the wedding ceremony, her husband shares one big secret.

Episodes.Title: The Aged Maiden In New Joseon
Episodes.Description: Yeon-woo ends up in Seoul in the present time. She nearly drowns in a swimming pool, but she gets rescued by Tae-ha, who is the grandson of Chairman Kang of SH Group in 2023. Without understanding the current situation, Yeon-woo ends up becoming Tae-ha’s bride. Chairman Kang’s surgery gets delayed, so Tae-ha has to pretend to be married until Chairman Kang leaves for the US. Tae-ha suggests Yeon-woo to draw up a contract regarding their fake marriage.

Episodes.Title: What a Toxic Lady !
Episodes.Description: Yeon-woo believes that she has found a way to go back to Joseon and heads to the pool where she first met Tae-ha in the 21st century. She soon gets caught by Tae-ha and happens to see a piece of painting from Joseon. With her knowledge of the old painting, she helps Tae-ha not to fall for Hye-suk’s scheme which could damage Tae-ha’s career.

Episodes.Title: The Fine Line Between Being Harmful and Beneficial
Episodes.Description: Tae-min announces to the whole family that he’ll start working at the company, fighting against Tae-ha to be a successor. He also warns his mother that he hasn’t decided which side to take. Chairman Kang’s birthday is held, and Yeon-woo meets Tae-ha’s whole family, including his aunt. She also runs into Sa-wol, who got hired as the family's new housekeeper.

Episodes.Title: Did We Connect ?
Episodes.Description: Hye-suk hands over another business proposal to Midam to make them decline Tae-ha's proposal. Furthermore, she uses Yeon-woo to raise the stakes about Tae-ha's marriage. Meanwhile, Yeon-woo wants to meet Chen-myung again to find the way back to Joseon.

Episodes.Title: Knot, A Loop Of Ties
Episodes.Description: Mi Dam decides to hire Yeon-woo as Midam’s guest designer after seeing her embroidery work. Through this, Yeon-woo gets to participate in SH Seoul’s first-anniversary event, which jars on Hye-suk’s nerves. Hye-suk lures Yeon-woo into the annexe of the family house, knowing Tae-ha hasn’t gotten over his trauma. Tae-ha runs into the annexe to save Yeon-woo, but his heart starts malfunctioning.

Episodes.Title: A Midsummer Night's Dream
Episodes.Description: The company's biggest event of the year, the first-anniversary event, is just around the corner. However, someone leaks Yeon-woo's collection all over the internet and gets Tae-ha into trouble. Chairman Kang tells Tae-ha and Yeon-woo to give up on the project.

Episodes.Title: On a Rainy, Windy Day
Episodes.Description: Tae-ha and the whole marketing team go on a vacation to Jeju Island. While Tae-ha is away, Hye-suk holds a general meeting to discuss Tae-ha’s dismissal due to his illness. Yeon-woo confesses her feelings for him, but Tae-ha tells him that they should end everything. Meanwhile, Sa-wol finds out that the Kang Family killed Yeon-woo.

Episodes.Title: What Links the Severed Tie
Episodes.Description: Yeon-woo is devastated upon uncovering that Tae-ha's family from Joseon directly contributed to her demise. Meanwhile, amidst this turmoil, Hye-suk is determined to diminish Tae-ha's sway, but her efforts may have crossed a precarious line.

Episodes.Title: The Shadow of the Truth
Episodes.Description: Ha-na reveals that she had been watching Tae-ha under Chairman Kang’s order. Tae-ha confronts his grandfather and finds out that it was him who killed Tae-ha’s mother. Yeon-woo sees Chairman Kang to ask him to apologize to Tae-ha if he truly loves him. Meanwhile, Mr. Hwang reveals his true identity to Chairman Kang.

Episodes.Title: A Night When Crape Myrtle Flowers Fall
Episodes.Description: Yeon-woo is prepared to go back to the Joseon she came from in order to save Tae-ha. In contrast to Yeon-woo, Tae-ha cannot come to terms with the idea of parting with her, regardless of the circumstances. The farewell is just two weeks away, and Tae-ha values every moment that could potentially be the last memory he shares with Yeon-woo.

Episodes.Title: Tie, The Second Month
Episodes.Description: Yeon Woo reveals that Lady Yoon tried to throw her into the well and poison her own son to death. Yeon Woo gets attacked by Duk Gu who escaped from the jail. But Yeon Woo thinks on her feet and escapes from his captive. Yeon Woo falls off a cliff while escaping, only to return to the new Joseon.

Entries.Title: Our Blooming Youth
Entries.Description: A rumor about how Prince Hwan has been cursed by a ghost has spread throughout the country. He has a dark secret he can't tell anyone. People who are trying to get Hwan dethroned prepare a trap and Hwan must stand against them. Meanwhile, the one who killed Hwan's Master comes to see him of her own free will.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A rumor about how Prince Hwan has been cursed by a ghost has spread throughout the country. He has a dark secret he can't tell anyone. People who are trying to get Hwan dethroned prepare a trap and Hwan must stand against them. Meanwhile, the one who killed Hwan's Master comes to see him of her own free will.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After facing a crisis at the hunting grounds, Hwan finds himself in an unbelievable situation. Jae-yi claims that she's innocent and blames Hwan for the death of her family. Hwan is confused when he finds out Jae-yi knows about his secret. Meanwhile, Jae-yi's servant disguises herself as a man to learn from the mad scientist, Kim Myeong-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Hwan can't trust Jae-yi and tells her to come find him in the East Palace on her own. To get there, Jae-yi turns herself into a eunuch. Meanwhile, Seong-on is shock to learn that his father might have something to do with the written prayer incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Hwan gives Jae-yi a second test. She must figure out why the messenger he sent to Master Min's house was killed and Jae-yi finds out it has something to do with Hwan. And finally, Hwan gives the last test which is to solve a serial murdercase. Now Jae-yi must face her fiancé.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Hwan, Jae-yi, Myeong-jin and Ga-ram finally meet. They head out to solve the Cardinal Point case. Meanwhile, Seong-on feels humiliated since he's competing against Sun-dol and feels upset when he sees Hwan and Sun-dol together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Jae-yi proves herself by solving the Cardial Point case and Hwan starts to trust her. Hwan listens to what happened to Jae-yi's family and trusts that she is innocent. Seong-on and Jae-yi run into each other by accident and she finds out Seong-on has been carrying something that has something to do with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After Hwan decides that he can't trust Jae-yi, he kicks her out of the palace. Ga-ram is ordered a chusoeryeong and is put in danger. Seong-on is curious as to why Hwan is looking into the case of his ex-fiancé and Hwan feels lonely now more than ever without Jae-yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The Prince's Guards and the War Department has a match of polo while Jae-yi watches. The interrogation of the shaman begins and she starts to curse the royal family which brings chaos to the capital and the palace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The palace and the capital is in chaos after the shaman's curse. Cho Won-bo turns the crisis into an opportunity and starts to pressure the royal family. Hwan and Jae-yi tried to prove that a human set fire to the plum tree and they find out that the real culpirt is someone they didn't expect.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: No description available

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After finding the royal secretary's journal suspicious, Hwan starts investigating what happened in Byeokcheon and the dried peony petals. After getting a mysterious letter, Cho Won-bo tries to subjugate the remnants of the thieves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Hwan teams up with Jae-yi and Seong-on to find a way to leave the palace after getting confined. Jae-yi finally remembers the face of the messenger who was at her house and is in shock. She runs to Hwan after realizing he's in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jae-yi claims that her memories are true, but Hwan trusts Tae-kang which confuses Jae-yi even more. Meanwhile, to each Myung-jin a lesson, Ga-ram steps up. Hwan leaves with Jae-yi and Seong-on after finding the man who tampered with the written prayer is in Paju and get themselves in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After returning to the palace, Hwan tries to send Jae-yi to Seong-on because he doesn't want Jae-yi to get hurt anymore. Meanwhile, a mysterious woman comes to Seong-on's house. The bounty hunters go to Jo Won-bo about Ga-ram and while having a good time at the inn, Hwan, Jae-yi, Myung-jin and Ga-ram are faced with another murder case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: The Manyeondang group manages to get the bracelet Shim Yeong gave to Jae-yi and start to figure out how Jae-yi's family was murdered. The King announces that the Crown Princess selection will take place soon, so Hwan gets ready to let Jae-yi go. Meanwhile, Prince Myeong-han, who was suffering from nightmares, says something shocking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: The Queen is furious that Won-bo used her son, Prince Myeong-ahn. Hwan tries to meet Park Han-su to find out what happened in Byeokcheon, but Jo Won-bo makes a move first to stop him from talking. Meanwhile, Princess Ha-yeon makes a risky decision to help Prince Myeong-ahn get better and the Manyeongdang group takes a huge step toward the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Princess Ha-yeon and Prince Myeong-ahn leaves the palace to meet Monk Mu-jin and an assassin follows them. Hwan and Jae-yi ask Tae-kang about the new mystery they unfolded, but Tae-kang says he doesn't know anything about it. Meanwhile, the Queen tells Seong-on the truth about Jae-yi and Jae-yi finds herself in danger.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Seong-on finds out Sun-dol is acutally Min Jae-yi and feels betrayed. Meanwhile, Tae-kang tells Hwan everything about his secret. Hwan, Jae-yi, Myung-jin and Ga-ram takes one step closer to the truth and starts to track down the secret letter Min Ho-seung left behind, but another crisis hits them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: After finding out what's written in the jikgeumdo, Hwan and Han Jung-eon are in shock and Jae-yi gets arrested for murder. Hwan is even more shocked to hear Jae-yi admit everything. Jo Won-bo demands that the Crown Prince gets deposed. Meanwhile, Seong-on gets an order from the Queen in secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: After finding out about the Queen's secret, Jo Won-bo is furious and the Queen makes a decision when Won-bo threatens her son. Meanwhile, the six arrive at Naewang Village and Hwan tries to convince them. Just then, Jo Won-bo comes once again to slaughter them.

Entries.Title: Black Knight
Entries.Description: 5-8 investigates the construction of a new district in post-apocalyptic Korea. Sa-wol and Seul-ah experience an unexpected attack.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: 5-8 investigates the construction of a new district in post-apocalyptic Korea. Sa-wol and Seul-ah experience an unexpected attack.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Seol-ah begins to investigate the recent tragedy. Sa-wol grapples with guilt. 5-8 discovers a dark scheme taking place in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: 5-8 warns Seol-ah about the chilling facts surrounding her investigation. Sa-wol partakes in an intense tournament in the hopes of becoming a deliveryman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Sa-wol advances to the final round. Ryu Seok reveals his disturbing plans for the upcoming migration, despite his father's opposition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of Ryu Seok's ploy, 5-8 plans to take him — and Cheonmyeong — down. Having finally achieved his dream, Sa-wol takes up his first mission.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Confronted with a crisis, Seok executes his endgame. 5-8 and Seol-ah team up to stop Cheonmyeong once and for all.

Entries.Title: Woman in a Veil
Entries.Description: After tying the knot with Yu Jin, Gyeo Ul moved in with him and his family. However, despite being her first birthday since the wedding, nobody in the household appears to have remembered or acknowledged it. Pressured by her mother-in-law to start a family, Gyeo Ul chooses to stop taking her bronchial medication. Meanwhile, Se Rin reunites with Tae Yang after a three-year absence, but he doesn't seem pleased to see her again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After tying the knot with Yu Jin, Gyeo Ul moved in with him and his family. However, despite being her first birthday since the wedding, nobody in the household appears to have remembered or acknowledged it. Pressured by her mother-in-law to start a family, Gyeo Ul chooses to stop taking her bronchial medication. Meanwhile, Se Rin reunites with Tae Yang after a three-year absence, but he doesn't seem pleased to see her again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Gyeo Ul is looking forward to her upcoming trip to a resort with Yu Jin, but she is unaware that Ae Ra, who she trusts the most, and is Yu Jin's mistress, will also be there. Tae Yang is unable to forgive himself for hurting someone and is experiencing great emotional pain because of it. Se Rin makes a foolish decision to help Tae Yang, but it leads to unforeseen condequences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Young Ran has been robbed by a pickpocket at the department store, and she suspects Tae Yang. When she finds out that Tae Yang has a criminal record, her suspicion turns into conviction. However, Gyeo Ul tries to clear up the misunderstanding which makes Young Ran take her anger out on her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Even though Hyun Tae forgives Yu Jin, he treats Gyeo Ul even more disrespectfully as soon as they leave his place. Se Rin blows up when Se Yeon sets her up on a blind date, and Se Yeon asks Tae Yang to move out of their house. Meanwhile, Ae Ra plots a scheme to sabotage Gyeo Ul to put out the affection Man Joong has for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Gyeo Ul investigates the earring and discovers that Yu Jin was its purchaser. Although Yu Jin and Ae Ra's deceitful explanations almost convince her, Gyeo Ul overhears something about Ae Ra's weekend activities that makes her suspicious. Meanwhile, Tae Yang informs his family of his desire to return to the sea, prompting Se Rin to initially react strongly but quickly compose herself and enact her backup plan to prevent Tae Yang from leaving.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Se Rin's blind date turns into a mess when Tae Yang takes the beating from her date while protecting her. Meanwhile, Ae Ra is consumed with worry that Gyeo Ul may acquire access to the corridor surveillance footage in the resort. As anticipated, Ae Ra doesn't think twice before putting Gyeo Ul to sleep in order to dispel her doubts with what she thinks is a foolproof scheme.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Se Rin finds out that she and Tae Yang have been deceived. In fact, Tae Yang has nothing to do with the murder charge he's been sentenced with. Se Rin right away looks deeper into the case, hoping to find evidence to prove Tae Yang's innocence. Meanwhile, the car accident was critical enough to take away Gyeo Ul's sight. On top of that, she needs to make a life-changing decision that involves tradeoffs.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin shows up at the hospital late after Gyeo Ul gives birth to their daughter. As Hyun Tae witnesses Yu Jin and Ae Ra together in front of the hospital, he can't shake off his concern for Gyeo Ul. Meanwhile, Se Yeon digs into the accident five years ago and finds out there was a real culprit who framed Tae Yang.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin kneels down in front of Hyun Tae and begs for forgiveness, which disappoints both Hyun Tae and Ae Ra. Hyun Tae visits Gyeo Ul the next day with a heavy heart, and Yu Jin's nerves are on the edge. Meanwhile, Se Yeon gets the actual name of Jang Mi through a detective agency and wants to meet her in person.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: When Se Yeon visits her with a barrage of questions, Ae Ra lies to escape a difficult situation. Se Rin, frustrated at not being able to clear Tae Yang's name, take it out on Se Yeon, leading to an argument. Meanwhile, Hyun Tae suspects an affair and follows Yu Jin, only to discover something strange about Gyeo Ul's bronchial medicine.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: After their misdeeds are revealed, Yu Jin and Ae Ra are in a difficult situation. They convince Hyun Tae that they can expedite Gyeo Ul's corneal transplant schedule to prevent him from exposing their secrets. Although hesitant at first, Hyun Tae ultimately agrees with their plan. Meanwhile, Se Yeon delves deeper into Ae Ra's background and takes a step that goes too far.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra covertly places what seems like a murder weapon inside Hyun Tae's car, which leads to his eventual arrest for murder. But just as she believes that the situation is under control, Ae Ra becomes the victim of blackmail by someone from her past who has a grudge against her. At the same time, Se Rin discovers Se Yeon's past and feels remorseful for how she has treated her lately.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Hyun Tae asks Yu Jin to come clean about his affair with Ae Ra to the police to defend himself from the false accusation of murder. Furthermore, Young Jun is searching everywhere for the organ trafficker, so Yu Jin and Ae Ra have to come up with another lie. Meanwhile, Se Rin gets infuriated at Se Yeon's funeral and is determined to take revenge for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: After her recent failure to seek revenge, Se Rin becomes even more determined to take extreme measures to achieve it. However, Tae Yang tries to prevent her from making impulsive decisions. Meanwhile, Hyun Tae is being held in solitary confinement by a corrupt officer at the detention center, and Ae Ra seeks alternative methods to make her family give up on Gyeo Ul.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra plans to convince Gyeo Ul to visit her imprisoned father secretly, intending to separate her from her daughter So Yi and isolate her from the family. Gyeo Ul later discovers her daughter is missing and cannot find her. Meanwhile, Se Rin's uncontrolled rage leads her to inflict more pain on Hyun Tae's family than she herself is experiencing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Gyeo Ul cannot deny the fact that she lost So Yi because of her. Not realizing how Ae Ra is behind the mess, Gyeo Ul decides that it would be better for her to stay at her parents' house until she finds So Yi. As Se Rin pursues her vendetta, Gyeo Ul becomes her next target. Later, an anonymous caller informs Gyeo Ul about a dashcam video that captures the woman who took So Yi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 17
Episodes.Description: Hyun Tae gets infuriated as he finds out it was Yu Jin and Ae Ra who stopped him from making calls and getting visitors, not Se Rin. Since he has no chance of getting in tough with anyone, he decides to break out of jail.

Episodes.Title: Episode 18
Episodes.Description: Hyun Tae collapses and is transferred to a public hospital as he did not take his pills. Meanwhile, Gyeo Ul and Young Jun try to sort things out while their father is hospitalized. Gyeo Ul tries to find out if the camera footage she saw at the resort is manipulated or not. Young Jun gets a lead on the organ trafficker who can confirm Hyun Tae's alibi.

Episodes.Title: Episode 19
Episodes.Description: Upon learning about Gyeo Ul's cornea transplant operation, Ae Ra formulates a scheme to deliberately sabotage it. When the surgery is unsuccessful, Ae Ra and Yu Jin openly ridicule Gyeo Ul, believing that as a blind person, she is powerless to retaliate. Despite facing opposition from all sides, Gyeo Ul remains steadfast in her resolve to hold Ae Ra and Yu Jin accountable for their actions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 20
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra wasn't sure if Gyeo Ul has regained her sight back or not, but she eventually figures it out. Now that she knows, she takes other measures to keep her quiet. While doing so, Ae Ra also finds out that she has something that doesn't belong to her and turns to even more extreme measures. Meanwhile, Se Rin realizes that Tae Yang was being honest when he said he wanted to go aboard with her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 21
Episodes.Description: After a miraculous event, Gyeo Ul finds herself in Se Rin's body due to a body switch. Now that five years have passed, Gyeo Ul is determined to take action to set things right. Meanwhile, despite Ae Ra's efforts, Yu Jin's family refuses to accept her as part of the family as long as Gyeo Ul has a chance of recovering from her vegetative state.

Episodes.Title: Episode 22
Episodes.Description: Se Rin learns that the USB hidden five years ago before the accident is in Tae Yang's bag. She decides to move into Jung Hye's house and live with them. Meanwhile, Yu Jin and Ae Ra plan to get divorce papers signed and stamped by threatening Gil Ja while Man Joong is away.

Episodes.Title: Episode 23
Episodes.Description: Gil Ja is about to sign the divorce papers for Yu Jin, but Young Jun gets released and has his charges dropped. Mal Ja tells everything about Yu Jin and Ae Ra to Man Joong. To get out of this trouble and to have him take herself in, Ae Ra takes on a difficult task at the company. However, if she manages to pull though, there might be hope for her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 24
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra's loss of a crucial photo jeopardizes her contract deal with VN Group and her manager position. Adding to her woes, she is transferred to a branch store and has a challenging day dealing with an unhappy customer. Meanwhile, Se Rin keeps tabs on Ae Ra for revenge, and Tae Yang searches for the deceased manager's family and Jang Mi to clear his name.

Episodes.Title: Episode 25
Episodes.Description: With Se Rin's assistance, Ae Ra is able to effectively close the deal with Chairman Pham and regain her position on the team. However, Se Rin intends to exploit Ae Ra's fabricated educational background to manipulate her. Meanwhile, Tae Yang is taking multiple measures to locate Jang Mi, but so far, he hasn't been able to find any leads on her whereabouts

Episodes.Title: Episode 26
Episodes.Description: Tae Yang finally gets a chance to inquire about the crucial missing security footage that could prove his innocence, but Ae Ra claims she has no knowledge of it or of Se Yeon. Meanwhile, Se Rin brings to light a rumour suggesting that Ae Ra may have fabricated her educational background.

Episodes.Title: Episode 27
Episodes.Description: Se Rin sees Tae Yang meet with Ae Ra. She finds their relationship suspicious and plans to get Tae Yang to join the YJ Group to stir things up. Meanwhile, Tae Yang saves Ji Seok in crisis while picking up Ha Neul at the welfare center and gets invited to Man Joong's house. Ae Ra sees Tae Yang at Man Joong's place and feels threatened.

Episodes.Title: Episode 28
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra tries to take Tae Yang apart from Man Joong by making him look like a thief. However, that plan does not fall through. On top of that, Se Rin secretly puts in an application for Tae Yang as a new recruit of YJ Group. If he gets the job and starts working with Ae Ra, he and Yu Jin might find out about each other's identity.

Episodes.Title: Episode 29
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra's involvement in revealing Tae Yang's criminal records to the public is aimed at hindering his job prospects, but Man Joong's decision ensures that Tae Yang can successfully go through the hiring procedures. Meanwhile, Se Rin devises a plan to create a rift between Yu Jin and Ae Ra, intending to utilize an upcoming investment meeting.

Episodes.Title: Episode 30
Episodes.Description: Se Rin eventually makes Yu Jin realize how Ae Ra has been lying to him all this time, and this triggers his interest in Se Rin to grow. Feeling the necessity for something more impactful, Se Rin plans to present a clear proof that explains Ae Ra's deceitfulness. Meanwhile, Young Jun finds the thugs that Gyeo Ul was running away from.

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin sees Ae Ra and Tae Yang together and takes it the wrong way. Ae Ra tries to mend her relationship with Yu Jin and attempts to win a contract with Gold Resort. Meanwhile, Se Rin notices the gap between Ae Ra and Yu Jin's relationship and sees her chance to seduce Yu Jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 32
Episodes.Description: Yu Jin slowly begins to fall for Se Rin's charms. However, he can't break up with Ae Ra since she got him recognized through the Gold Resort deal. Meanwhile, Young Jun is determined to find evidence of Yu Jin and Ae Ra's involvement in Gyeo Ul's accident by joining the YJ Group.

Episodes.Title: Episode 33
Episodes.Description: After waking up in Se Rin's room, Yu Jin can't keep his mind off her. He looks for a way to break up with Ae Ra so that he can continue to see Se Rin. Meanwhile, Ae Ra finds it suspicious that Young Jun started working at the company and plans to get rid of him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 34
Episodes.Description: Young Jun is perplexed by Se Rin's eagerness to assist him in clearing his name of sexual harassment allegations and making amends for the past. Meanwhile, Se Rin devises a plan to get back at Ae Ra, who colluded with Manager Mo to accuse Young Jun of sexual harassment. To compound Ae Ra's troubles, Se Rin creates the impression that Yu Jin is concealing something from her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 35
Episodes.Description: Se Rin's scheming unfolds smoothly, causing Ae Ra to suspect that Yu Jin is romantically involved with Manager Mo. This prompts Ae Ra to track Yu Jin's phone in an attempt to uncover evidence of their supposed secret affair. At the same time, Yu Jin grows increasingly irritated by the close relationship between Tae Yang and Se Rin, and seeks ways to distance Tae Yang from Se Rin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 36
Episodes.Description: Se Rin almost gets found by Ae Ra, who was tracking Yu Jin's phone. However, Se Rin manages to escape the crisis with Yu Jin's help. After learning about Se Rin and Yu Jin's relationship, Tae Yang tries to stop Se Rin, but she doesn't listen. Meanwhile, Ae Ra grills Yu Jin about seeing another woman, but gets caught by Young Ran, who scolds her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 37
Episodes.Description: After learning Ae Ra's secret, Se Rin pushes Ae Ra to break up with Yu Jin, and Ae Ra struggles to find a way out of Se Rin and bar owner's threat. Meanwhile, Se Rin plans a on moving out of Jung Hye's house before Ae Ra learns about her relationship with Se Yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 38
Episodes.Description: Although Ae Ra learns something about the bar owner and uses it to escape his blackmail, she can't find anything on Se Rin. She decides to get rid of Se Rin instead. Meanwhile, Tae Yang realises he likes Se Rin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 39
Episodes.Description: Se Rin's attempt to elicit a confession from Ae Ra falls apart when Tae yang becomes involved. As Ae Ra becomes aware of Se Rin's intention to reveal everything to Yu Jin, she pleads for another opportunity to make amends. Meanwhile, Tae Yang's perception of Se Rin undergoes a change, and he opens up about his feeling for her. However, Ae Ra realises this and uses it to her advantage.

Episodes.Title: Episode 40
Episodes.Description: Having recently experienced a major life crisis, Yu Jin finds himself unable to think clearly and instead relies on Ae Ra's assistance. However, as anticipated, Ae Ra's support comes at a cost. In this case, Yu Jin's commitment to Ae Ra becomes the price to pay. Meanwhile, Ae Ra seizes this opportunity to undermine Yu Jin and Se Rin's relationship. Se Rin becomes suspicious of Yu Jin's recent behaviour of avoiding her.

Episodes.Title: Episode 41
Episodes.Description: Se Rin becomes aware of Ae Ra's actions, and Yu Jin continues to feel guilty for something he didn't do.

Episodes.Title: Episode 42
Episodes.Description: Young Jun becomes suspicious of Se Rin after hearing her call Gill Ja "Mom" and seeing her visit her in the hospital. YJ Group gets thrown into chaos over leaked documents by Yu Ri concerning a patent that has Young Jun scrambling to resolve. Meanwhile, Ae Ra takes advantage of the situation to win over Young Ran's heart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 43
Episodes.Description: Se Rin thinks Ae Ra could've been the one who attempted to kill Gyeo UI and starts to look for evidence. Ae Ra finds out about Se Rin's attempt to find evidence and tries to stop her. Meanwhile, Ae Ra suspects a connection between Se Rin and Gyeo UI

Episodes.Title: Episode 44
Episodes.Description: Ae Ra decides to falsely implicate Se Rin as the assailant in Gyeo UI's attempted murder, with the intention of probing the true extent of Se Rin and Gyeo UI's relationship. Meanwhile, Young Jun finds it peculiar to observe Ae Ra standing at a distance, watching Se Rin talk with the police, Furthermore, Se Rin's actions consistently evoke old memories of Gyeo UI within Young Jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 45
